<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;"><b><a id="item1" href="#"></a>ITEM <span style="line-height: inherit; display: inline;" id="fs_M47UV82PIO00000000000000000000fs">1</span></b></span></p>
<div style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left;"><a style="text-decoration: none; color: #000000; cursor: default; outline: none; pointer-events: none;" href="#TOC" id="Bs12_91120242362188"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;"><b>BUSINESS</b></span></a></div>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">Business Overview</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">Hovnanian Enterprises, Inc. (&#8220;HEI&#8221;) conducts all of its homebuilding and financial services operations through its subsidiaries (references herein to the &#8220;Company,&#8221; &#8220;we,&#8221; &#8220;us&#8221; or &#8220;our&#8221; refer to HEI and its consolidated subsidiaries and should be understood to reflect the consolidated business of HEI&#8217;s subsidiaries). Through its subsidiaries, HEI designs, constructs, markets, and sells single-family detached homes, attached townhomes and condominiums,&#160;urban infill, and active lifestyle homes in planned residential developments and is <span style="line-height: inherit; display: inline;" id="fs_8QF9WKQQQO00000000000000000000fs">one</span> of the nation&#8217;s largest builders of residential homes. Founded in <span style="line-height: inherit; display: inline;" id="fs_BV1VYPTJB400000000000000000000fs">1959</span> by Kevork Hovnanian, HEI was incorporated in New Jersey in <span style="line-height: inherit; display: inline;" id="fs_9PPFT3DICG00000000000000000000fs">1967</span> and reincorporated in Delaware in <span style="line-height: inherit; display: inline;" id="fs_TONAI0Q0G000000000000000000000fs">1983</span>. Since the incorporation of HEI&#8217;s predecessor company, the Company combined with its unconsolidated joint ventures have delivered in excess of <span style="line-height: inherit; display: inline;" id="fs_CIRYU6IVG000000000000000000000fs">382,000</span> homes, including <span id="fs_A13UDVEN7K00000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">6,431</span> homes in fiscal <span style="line-height: inherit; display: inline;" id="fs_7GK65EJGJ400000000000000000000fs">2025</span>. The Company has <span style="line-height: inherit; display: inline;" id="fs_9F8TXBH68000000000000000000000fs">two</span> distinct operations: homebuilding and financial services. Our homebuilding operations consist of <span style="line-height: inherit; display: inline;" id="fs_8YTVR0IUO000000000000000000000fs">three</span> reportable segments: Northeast, Southeast and West. Our financial services operations provide mortgage loans and title services to the customers of our homebuilding operations.</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">Excluding unconsolidated joint ventures, we are currently offering homes for sale in <span id="fs_HLA6XD8AG000000000000000000000FM" style="display: inline;">140</span> communities in&#160;<span id="fs_FD3NIP1NNK00000000000000000000FM" style="display: inline;">27</span>&#160;markets in&#160;<span id="fs_79BT0NW28000000000000000000000FM" style="display: inline;">13</span>&#160;states throughout the United States. We market and build homes for first-time buyers, move-up buyers, luxury buyers, active lifestyle buyers and empty nesters. We offer a variety of home styles at base prices ranging from $<span style="border-left: none; border-right: none;"><span id="fs_SPLYFPDDY800000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">182,000</span></span> to $<span style="border-left: none; border-right: none;"><span id="fs_AE13T82XPC00000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">1,191,000</span></span> with an average sales price, including options, of $<span style="border-left: none; border-right: none;"><span id="fs_KSD9GGCDKG00000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">519,000</span></span> nationwide in fiscal <span style="border-left: none; border-right: none;"><span id="fs_EIJSERI05C00000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">2025</span></span>.</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt 15pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">Our operations span all significant aspects of the home-buying process &#8211; from design, construction, and sale, to mortgage origination and title services.</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 45pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">The following is a summary of our growth history:</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 45pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;"><span style="line-height: inherit; display: inline;" id="fs_Z87PDF20PS00000000000000000000fs">1959</span> - Founded by Kevork Hovnanian as a New Jersey homebuilder.</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 45pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;"><span style="line-height: inherit; display: inline;" id="fs_LLQN9G5UIO00000000000000000000fs">1983</span> - Completed initial public offering.</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 45pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;"><span style="line-height: inherit; display: inline;" id="fs_023ACRKC0000000000000000000000fs">1986</span> - Entered the North Carolina market through the investment in New Fortis Homes.</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 45pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;"><span style="line-height: inherit; display: inline;" id="fs_96GGTTOOCW00000000000000000000fs">1992</span> - Entered the greater Washington, D.C. market.</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 45pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;"><span style="line-height: inherit; display: inline;" id="fs_3JINTCHYIO00000000000000000000fs">1994</span> - Entered the Coastal Southern California market.</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 45pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;"><span style="line-height: inherit; display: inline;" id="fs_3MQOPVKTZ400000000000000000000fs">1998</span> - Expanded in the greater Washington, D.C. market through the acquisition of P.C. Homes.</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 45pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;"><span style="line-height: inherit; display: inline;" id="fs_QRIXHKJTE800000000000000000000fs">1999</span> - Entered the Dallas, Texas market through our acquisition of Goodman Homes. Further diversified and strengthened our position as New Jersey&#8217;s largest homebuilder through the acquisition of Matzel &amp; Mumford.</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 45pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;"><span style="line-height: inherit; display: inline;" id="fs_RLCRYWTQC000000000000000000000fs">2001</span> - Continued expansion in the greater Washington D.C. and North Carolina markets through the acquisition of Washington Homes. This acquisition further strengthened our operations in each of these markets.</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 45pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;"><span style="line-height: inherit; display: inline;" id="fs_BNY73DHB9C00000000000000000000fs">2002</span> - Entered the Central Valley market in Northern California and Inland Empire region of Southern California through the acquisition of Forecast Homes.</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 45pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;"><span style="line-height: inherit; display: inline;" id="fs_QHMV33EYN400000000000000000000fs">2003</span> - Expanded operations in Texas and entered the Houston market through the acquisition of Parkside Homes and Brighton Homes. Entered the greater Ohio market through our acquisition of Summit Homes and entered the greater metro Phoenix market through our acquisition of Great Western Homes.</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 45pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;"><span style="line-height: inherit; display: inline;" id="fs_9ROYV4C7ZK00000000000000000000fs">2004</span> - Entered the greater Tampa, Florida market through the acquisition of Windward Homes and started operations in the Minneapolis/St. Paul, Minnesota market.</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0px; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; text-indent: 0px; line-height: 1.2;"><br/></p>

<p style="margin: 10pt 0pt 0pt 45pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2; text-indent: 0pt;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;"><span style="line-height: inherit; display: inline;" id="fs_9FJLIAUKG000000000000000000000fs">2005</span> - Entered the Orlando, Florida market through our acquisition of Cambridge Homes and entered the greater Chicago, Illinois market and expanded our position in Florida and Minnesota through the acquisition of the operations of Town &amp; Country Homes, which occurred concurrently with our entering into a joint venture with affiliates of Blackstone Real Estate Advisors to own and develop Town &amp; Country Homes&#8217; existing residential communities. We also entered the Cleveland, Ohio market through the acquisition of Oster Homes.</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt 7.5pt 0pt 52.5pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 45pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;"><span style="line-height: inherit; display: inline;" id="fs_TNTZ4H2O0W00000000000000000000fs">2006</span> - Entered the coastal markets of South Carolina and Georgia through the acquisition of Craftbuilt Homes.</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt 15pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">During fiscal <span style="line-height: inherit; display: inline;" id="fs_LY6AK1QMKG00000000000000000000fs">2016</span>, we exited the Minneapolis, Minnesota and Raleigh, North Carolina markets and sold land portfolios in those markets. During fiscal <span style="line-height: inherit; display: inline;" id="fs_4UOX5ZJ5S000000000000000000000fs">2018</span>, we completed a wind-down of our operations in the San Francisco Bay area in Northern California and in Tampa, Florida. During fiscal <span style="line-height: inherit; display: inline;" id="fs_Z4ONF1Y1I800000000000000000000fs">2020</span>, we began&#160;a wind-down of our operations in the&#160;Chicago, Illinois market which was completed in fiscal <span style="line-height: inherit; display: inline;" id="fs_OG6788ST2800000000000000000000fs">2023</span>.</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;"><b>Geographic Breakdown of Markets by Segment</b></span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt 15pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">The Company markets and builds homes that are constructed in <span id="fs_JHNM2SFBQ800000000000000000000FM" style="display: inline;">17</span> of the nation&#8217;s top <span style="line-height: inherit; display: inline;" id="fs_PS4DLUPBZ400000000000000000000fs">50</span> housing markets. We segregate our homebuilding operations geographically into the following <span style="line-height: inherit; display: inline;" id="fs_B1I5FFLQU800000000000000000000fs">three</span> segments:</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt 7.5pt 0pt 52.5pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 45pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">Northeast: Delaware, Maryland, New Jersey, Ohio, Pennsylvania, Virginia and West Virginia</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 45pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">Southeast: Florida, Georgia and South Carolina</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 45pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">West: Arizona, California and Texas</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 45pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; text-indent: 0pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 8pt; text-indent: 36pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">For financial information about our segments, see Item <span style="line-height: inherit; display: inline;" id="fs_M5CT5AY3IO00000000000000000000fs">7</span>&#160;&#8220;Management&#8217;s&#160;Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations.&#8221;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt 15pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;"><b>Human Capital</b></span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; text-indent: 45pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">As of <span style="line-height: inherit;" id="fs_ECH5CSPAYO00000000000000000000FM">October 31, 2025</span>, we employed <span style="border-left: none; border-right: none;"><span id="fs_AAK7MSO5HC00000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">1,891</span></span> full-time associates of whom <span style="border-left: none; border-right: none;"><span id="fs_4ZAZBGILOG00000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">1,194</span></span> were involved in our homebuilding operations, <span style="border-left: none; border-right: none;"><span id="fs_J4IAJKXAM800000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">186</span></span> were involved in our financial services operations and <span style="border-left: none; border-right: none;"><span id="fs_M0BXAD517400000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">511</span></span> were involved in our corporate operations. We do not have collective bargaining agreements relating to any of our associates.</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; text-indent: 45pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; text-indent: 45pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">Successful execution of our strategy is dependent on attracting, developing and retaining key associates and members of our management team. The skills, experience and industry knowledge of our team significantly benefit our operations and performance. We continuously evaluate, modify, and enhance our internal processes and technologies to increase engagement, productivity, efficiency and the skills our associates need to be successful.</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; text-indent: 45pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; text-indent: 45pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">We believe that talented associates are the Company&#8217;s greatest asset and play a key role in creating long-term value for our stakeholders. As of <span style="line-height: inherit;" id="fs_01I1IRFW0000000000000000000000FM">October 31, 2025</span>, <span style="border-left: none; border-right: none;"><span id="fs_ZBRA9Z80A800000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">16</span></span>% of our associates had been with the Company for more than <span style="border-left: none; border-right: none;"><span id="fs_3MJEJOBUHS00000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">15</span></span> years, and the average tenure of all associates was approximately <span style="color: #000000; font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 60px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important;"><span id="fs_O1SRGLFJ5S00000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">7</span></span>&#160;years. We understand that our ultimate success and ability to compete are significantly dependent on how well we identify, hire, train, and retain highly qualified personnel. We realize that each associate has a unique vision and their own special talents. We are committed to being an employer that fosters the growth of each associate, while building an inclusive and diverse workforce.</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; text-indent: 45pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span><br/></span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; text-indent: 45pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span>The Company is also a founding member of the Building Talent Foundation (<span style="color: #000000; font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: start; text-indent: 48px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important;">&#8220;</span>BTF<span style="color: #000000; font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: start; text-indent: 48px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important;">&#8221;</span>) whose mission is to advance the education, training and careers of people from underrepresented groups in the fields of skilled technical workers and as business owners in the residential construction industry. <p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; text-indent: 45pt; line-height: 1.2;"><br/></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; text-indent: 45pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">Through a combination of competitive benefits and educational programs, we believe that we positively contribute to the well-being of our associates and the communities in which they live and work. Our benefits packages include medical, dental, and vision coverage, as well as paid parental leave, health savings accounts, life insurance, disability income, <span style="line-height: inherit; display: inline;">401</span>(k) savings plan with a company match and other assistance and wellness programs. Together, these benefits help keep our associates and their dependents healthy, while giving them tax-advantaged ways to save for retirement and establish long-term financial security. This package of programs is routinely reevaluated in order to meet the changing needs of our associates in our diverse organization.</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; text-indent: 45pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; text-indent: 45pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">In light of the Company&#8217;s experience managing the novel coronavirus (<span style="color: #000000; font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: start; text-indent: 48px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important;">&#8220;</span>COVID-<span style="line-height: inherit; display: inline;">19</span><span style="color: #000000; font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: start; text-indent: 48px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important;">&#8221;</span>) pandemic and the recognition of the associated environmental benefits, the Company previously introduced a hybrid work schedule and continued its use throughout fiscal <span style="border-left: none; border-right: none;"><span id="fs_4O5RB8CX2O00000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">2025</span></span>, whereby most office associates may work <span style="line-height: inherit; display: inline;">two</span> days a week from home. We believe a hybrid work model promotes a healthier work and home life balance for our associates while simultaneously providing the environmental benefits of having fewer vehicles on the road. In addition to the weekly hybrid schedule, non-field associates can work remotely up to <span style="line-height: inherit; display: inline;">eight</span> weeks a year.&#160;</span></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">We also have committed considerable resources to furthering our associates&#8217; personal and professional growth.&#160;<span style="font-size: 10.0pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman',serif; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-font-kerning: 0pt; mso-ligatures: none; mso-ansi-language: EN-US; mso-fareast-language: EN-US; mso-bidi-language: AR-SA;">Effective
January 1, 2026, we plan to reinstate the tuition reimbursement benefit, which has been suspended since May 2009.&#160;Additionally, w</span>e offer a comprehensive library of over <span style="line-height: inherit; display: inline;" id="fs_6RLM7PF2SG00000000000000000000fs">500</span> training modules/courses to facilitate learning sessions both in-person and virtually, including required courses on diversity, ethics, workplace harassment prevention, cybersecurity&#160;and safety training courses.</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; text-indent: 45pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;"><b>Corporate Offices and Available Information</b></span></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">Our corporate offices are located at <span style="line-height: inherit; display: inline;" id="fs_7TOWD6E68W00000000000000000000fs">90</span> Matawan Road, Fifth Floor, Matawan, New Jersey <span style="line-height: inherit; display: inline;" id="fs_NTT9KRC4AO00000000000000000000fs">07747</span> (See Item <span style="line-height: inherit; display: inline;" id="fs_JW62HIJRSG00000000000000000000fs">2</span>&#160;<span style="color: #000000; font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 60px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important;">&#8220;</span>Properties<span style="color: #000000; font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 60px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important;">&#8221;</span>). <p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;"><b>Business Strategies </b></span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; text-indent: 45pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;"><span style="color: #000000; font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 60px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important;">In response to changing market conditions, we have taken a disciplined and strategic approach to our new land purchases at price points that we believe will generate appropriate investment returns needed to sustain profitability, while taking into consideration the current market environment of elevated sales concessions.&#160;</span><span>The housing market continues to be driven by positive fundamentals and as a result we increased our community count and continued to invest in land and land development during the year.&#160;</span><span style="color: #000000; font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 60px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important;">In addition, we intend to continue to focus on our historic key business strategies, as enumerated below. We believe that these strategies separate us from our competitors in the residential homebuilding industry and the adoption, implementation and adherence to these principles will continue to benefit our business.</span></span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; text-indent: 45pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;"><br/></span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; text-indent: 45pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">As a result of the sharp increase in interest rates that began in fiscal <span style="line-height: inherit; display: inline;" id="fs_PSWQ4LUHJ400000000000000000000fs">2022</span>, we have shifted our focus to increasing the availability of quick-move-in homes (&#8220;QMI homes&#8221;). The rationale behind this shift in focus is that QMI homes provide our customers with more certainty on what their mortgage payments will be at closing.&#160;QMI homes also allow us to offer customers mortgage rate buydowns that would be cost prohibitive on homes with a longer time until delivery. QMI homes greatly reduce the complexity of choices for our customers and significantly increase efficiencies for our trades, construction and purchasing teams. Beginning in fiscal <span style="line-height: inherit; display: inline;" id="fs_YS8VPKVWKW00000000000000000000fs">2023</span>, we began executing&#160;<span style="color: #000000; font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 60px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important;">&#8220;</span>Build-For-Rent<span style="color: #000000; font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 60px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important;">&#8221;</span> agreements to supplement our existing for sale business. The Build-For-Rent sales channel added incremental deliveries during fiscal years 2025,&#160;<span style="line-height: inherit; display: inline;" id="fs_21KWIAX38W00000000000000000000fs">2024</span> and&#160;<span id="fs_3X6D25W4KG00000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">2023</span>, which allowed us to increase inventory turnover.</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">We remain focused on maintaining adequate&#160;liquidity and identifying investment opportunities that make economic sense in light of our current sales prices and sales paces. Our excess liquidity in fiscal years <span style="line-height: inherit;" id="fs_7X5PE7CTIO00000000000000000000fs">2025</span>, <span style="line-height: inherit;" id="fs_0EZA71K8R400000000000000000000fs">2024</span> and <span style="line-height: inherit;" id="fs_BO651W5MM800000000000000000000fs">2023</span> allowed us to repurchase $<span style="border-left: none; border-right: none;"><span id="fs_S85T3CE5NK00000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">26.6</span></span>&#160;million, $<span style="color: #000000; font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 60px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important;"><span id="fs_DMFPM4YFTC00000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">113.5</span></span>&#160;million and $<span style="color: #000000; font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 60px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important;"><span id="fs_BC2OESAMDC00000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">245.0</span></span>&#160;million in aggregate principal of senior secured notes, respectively. <span style="color: #000000; font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 60px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important;">In May 2024, we completed a debt exchange resulting in a $</span><span>75.3</span><span style="color: #000000; font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 60px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important;"><span>&#160;</span>million principal reduction of our senior notes and term loans, which included an aggregate cash payment of $</span><span>31.5</span><span style="color: #000000; font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 60px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important;"><span>&#160;</span>million.<span>&#160;</span></span>In September 2025, we issued $<span id="fs_9KONAOGI0000000000000000000000FM" style="display: inline;">900.0</span> million in aggregate principal amount of senior notes. The net proceeds therefrom, along with&#160;cash on hand, were used to redeem the entire principal amount of our then outstanding senior secured notes and payoff in full our secured term loan credit facility. We&#160;also extended the maturity date of our senior secured revolving credit facility to June 2028. In addition to the debt transactions, during fiscal years&#160;<span id="fs_YDIQVVXOOW00000000000000000000FM">2025</span>, <span id="fs_IYJRBYFVHC00000000000000000000FM">2024</span> and <span id="fs_587VSK9QYO00000000000000000000FM">2023</span>, we also repurchased&#160;<span id="fs_YKN1IH4FEO00000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">257,908</span>&#160;shares, <span id="fs_3U9N9IN53K00000000000000000000FM">188,800</span> shares and <span id="fs_56U5YEMW8G00000000000000000000FM">118,478</span> shares, respectively, of our Class A common stock with an aggregate market value of $<span style="color: #000000; font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 60px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important;"><span id="fs_CVRLVXRNG000000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">30.1</span></span> million, $<span id="fs_GCG1EMYPKW00000000000000000000FM">26.5</span> million and $<span id="fs_C0BFXOP95C00000000000000000000FM">4.8</span> million, respectively.&#160;<span style="font-size: 10.0pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman',serif; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-ansi-language: EN-US; mso-fareast-language: EN-US; mso-bidi-language: AR-SA;">These strategic actions contributed to our
ongoing efforts to manage and simplify the Company&#8217;s capital structure and
strengthen its financial position. </span>


</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0px; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><br/></p>

<div class="pageBreak" style="page-break-before: always; font-size: 10pt; text-align: left;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;"><a href="#TOC">Table of Contents</a></span></div>





























































 </div>
<p style="margin: 10pt 0pt 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">Our goal is to become a significant builder in each of the selected markets in which we operate, which will enable us to achieve economies of scale and differentiate ourselves from most of our competitors.</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">As noted above, we offer a broad product array to provide housing to a wide range of customers.&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">We are committed to customer satisfaction and quality in the homes that we build. We recognize that our future success rests on the ability to deliver quality homes to satisfied customers. We seek to expand our commitment to customer service through a variety of quality initiatives. In addition, we remain focused on attracting and developing quality associates. See <span style="color: #000000; font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 60px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important;">&#8220;</span>Human Capital<span style="color: #000000; font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 60px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important;">&#8221;</span> above for further discussion.</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">We focus on achieving high returns on invested capital. Each new community is evaluated based on its ability to meet or exceed internal rate of return requirements. Our belief is that the best way to create lasting value for our shareholders is through a strong focus on return on invested capital.</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">We prefer to use a risk-averse land acquisition strategy. We attempt to acquire land with a minimum cash investment and negotiate takedown options, thereby limiting the financial exposure to the amounts invested in property and predevelopment costs. This approach significantly reduces our risk and generally allows us to obtain necessary development approvals before acquisition of the land.</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">Our strategy also includes homebuilding and land development joint ventures as a means of controlling lot positions, expanding our market opportunities, establishing strategic alliances, reducing our risk profile, leveraging our capital base and enhancing our returns on capital. Our homebuilding joint ventures are generally entered into with third-party investors to develop land and construct homes that are sold directly to home buyers. Our land development joint ventures include those with developers and other homebuilders, as well as financial investors to develop finished lots for sale to the joint venture&#8217;s members or other third-parties.</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">We manage our financial services operations to better serve all of our home buyers. Our current mortgage financing and title service operations enhance our contact with customers and allow us to coordinate the home-buying experience from beginning to end. Further, we are able to employ a range of pricing incentives through our mortgage financing operations, including temporary and permanent mortgage rate buy downs, which are tools that provide buyers with the opportunity to secure mortgage rates below market level.</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;"><b>Operating Policies and Procedures</b></span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">We attempt to reduce the effect of certain risks inherent in the housing industry through the following policies and procedures:</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;"><i>Training</i> - Our training is designed to provide our associates with the knowledge, attitudes, skills and habits necessary to succeed in their jobs. Our training department regularly conducts in-person, online or webinar training in sales, construction, administration and managerial skills.</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">&#160;&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;"><i>Land Acquisition, Planning, and Development</i> - Before entering into a contract to acquire land, we complete extensive comparative studies and analyses which assist us in evaluating the economic feasibility of such land acquisition.</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt 22.7pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<div style="line-height: 1.2;" id="t_ft_DS4YDELEE800000000000000000000b">

<td style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; width: 92.0527%;">
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: justify; font-family: Times New Roman; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;"> Where possible, we acquire land for future development through the use of land options, which need not be exercised before the completion of the regulatory approval process. We attempt to structure these options with flexible takedown schedules rather than with an obligation to take down the entire parcel upon receiving regulatory approval. If we are unable to negotiate flexible takedown schedules, we will buy parcels in a single bulk purchase. Additionally, we purchase improved lots in certain markets by acquiring a small number of improved lots with an option on additional lots. This allows us to minimize the economic costs and risks of carrying a large inventory of land, while maintaining our ability to commence new developments during favorable market periods. </span></p>

<div class="pageBreak" style="page-break-before: always; font-size: 10pt; text-align: left;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;"><a href="#TOC">Table of Contents</a></span></div>

<p style="margin: 10pt 0pt 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;"><i>Design</i> - Our residential communities are generally located in urban and suburban areas easily accessible through public and personal transportation. Our communities are designed as neighborhoods that fit existing land characteristics. We strive to create diversity within the overall planned community by offering a mix of homes with differing architecture, textures and colors.<b> </b>Recreational amenities, such as swimming pools, tennis courts, clubhouses, open areas and tot lots, are frequently included.</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt 7.5pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;"><i>Construction</i> - We design and supervise the development and building of our communities. Our homes are constructed according to standardized prototypes, which are designed and engineered to provide innovative product design while attempting to minimize costs of construction. We generally employ subcontractors for the installation of site improvements and construction of homes. Agreements with subcontractors are generally short term and provide for a fixed price for labor and materials. We rigorously control costs through the use of computerized monitoring systems.&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt 7.5pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">Because of the risks involved in speculative building, our general policy is to construct an attached condominium or townhouse building only after signing contracts for the sale of at least <span style="line-height: inherit; display: inline;" id="fs_VKYCNHST5C00000000000000000000fs">50</span>% of the homes in that building. Historically, a majority of our single-family detached homes were constructed after the signing of a sales contract and mortgage approval was obtained, which limits the buildup of inventory of unsold homes and the costs of maintaining and carrying that inventory. We are actively managing the number of QMI homes in connection with our current business strategy discussed above.</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;"><i>Materials</i>&#160;- We attempt to maintain efficient operations by utilizing standardized materials available from a variety of sources. We have reduced construction and administrative costs by consolidating the number of vendors serving certain markets and by executing national purchasing contracts with select vendors. Due to the COVID-<span style="line-height: inherit; display: inline;" id="fs_I0N5TA9ZR400000000000000000000fs">19</span> pandemic, we experienced construction delays from shortages in the supply of materials, as well as labor shortages in all of our markets. The impact and the particular materials associated with the delays varied from market to market. We have improved our cycle times since the beginning of fiscal <span style="line-height: inherit; display: inline;" id="fs_OA4EQPU5YO00000000000000000000fs">2023</span> by approximately <span style="line-height: inherit; display: inline;" id="fs_HU88O3FIU800000000000000000000fs">30</span> days, which brings us closer to our pre-pandemic average in many of our markets. We cannot predict the extent to which shortages in necessary materials or labor will re-occur in our markets in the future.</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt 7.5pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;"><i>Marketing and Sales</i> - Our homes in residential communities are sold principally through on-site sales offices. In order to respond to our customers&#8217; needs and trends in housing design, we rely upon our internal market research group to analyze information gathered from, among other sources, buyer profiles, exit interviews at model sites, focus groups and demographic databases. We make use of our website, internet, newspaper, radio, television, magazine, billboard, video and direct mail advertising, special and promotional events, illustrated brochures and full-sized and scale model homes in our comprehensive marketing program. We also offer&#160;curated <span style="color: #000000; font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 60px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important;">&#8220;</span>Looks<span style="color: #000000; font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 60px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important;">&#8221;</span> packages for customers to select, rather than a large number of a la carte options. This approach provides customers with a more streamlined selection process and allows us to be more efficient in purchasing, sales and construction.&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">We have a national call center which is responsible for follow up generated by&#160;our website and our digital marketing efforts. The call center supports our ability to swiftly respond to incoming customer leads,&#160;schedule and conduct virtual tours and video chats, as well as set up in person model home tours.</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt 7.5pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;"><i>Customer Service and Quality Control</i> - In many of our markets, associates are responsible for customer service and preclosing quality control inspections as well as responding to post-closing customer needs. Prior to closing, each home is inspected, and any necessary completion work is undertaken by us or our subcontractors. Our homes are enrolled in a standard limited warranty program which, in general, provides a homebuyer with a limited warranty for the home&#8217;s materials and workmanship which follows each state&#8217;s applicable statute of repose. All of the warranties contain standard exceptions, including, but not limited to, damage caused by the customer.</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt 7.5pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;"><i>Customer Financing</i> - We sell our homes to customers who generally finance their purchases through mortgages. Our financial services segment provides our customers with competitive financing and coordinates and expedites the loan origination transaction through the steps of loan application, loan approval, and closing and title services. We originate loans in each of the states in which we build homes. We believe that our ability to offer financing to customers on competitive terms as a part of the sales process is an important factor in completing sales.</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt 7.5pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="margin: 10pt 0pt 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">During the year ended <span style="line-height: inherit;" id="fs_BGITUMDRMO00000000000000000000FM">October 31, 2025</span>, for the markets in which our mortgage subsidiaries originated loans, <span style="color: #000000; font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important;"><span id="fs_HVJ6J7DUUO00000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">20.2</span></span>% of our home buyers paid in cash and&#160;<span style="color: #000000; font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important;"><span id="fs_EK44ZGTI9C00000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">80.0</span></span>% of our noncash home buyers obtained mortgages from our mortgage banking subsidiary. The loans we originated in fiscal <span style="border-left: none; border-right: none;"><span id="fs_GLDRC8XEIO00000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">2025</span></span>&#160;were <span style="color: #000000; font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important;"><span id="fs_PWQPCDDNXS00000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">58.7</span></span>% conforming conventional loans and <span style="color: #000000; font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important;"><span id="fs_DBG7D1EC7K00000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">40.3</span></span>% Federal Housing Administration/Veterans Affairs (&#8220;FHA/VA&#8221;). The remaining <span style="color: #000000; font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important;"><span id="fs_X4BFZ95GRK00000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">1.0</span></span>% of our loan originations represented loans which exceeded conforming conventions.</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt 7.5pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">&#160;&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">We sell virtually all of the loans and loan-servicing rights that we originate within a short period of time. Loans are sold either individually or against forward commitments to institutional investors, including banks, mortgage banking firms, and savings and loan associations.</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt 7.5pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;"><b>Residential Development Activities</b></span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">Our residential development activities include site planning and engineering, obtaining environmental and other regulatory approvals and constructing roads, sewer, water, and drainage facilities, recreational facilities, and other amenities and marketing and selling homes. These activities are performed by our associates, together with independent architects, consultants and contractors. Our associates also conduct long-term planning of communities. A residential development generally includes single-family detached homes and/or a number of residential buildings containing from <span style="line-height: inherit; display: inline;" id="fs_AMRFEBKIM800000000000000000000fs">two</span> to <span style="line-height: inherit; display: inline;" id="fs_CBCQON468G00000000000000000000fs">24</span> individual homes per building, together with recreational amenities, such as swimming pools, tennis courts, clubhouses, open areas and tot lots.&#160;</span><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;"><i style="color: #000000; font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 13.3333px; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: #ffffff; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial;"><b></b></i></span></p>

font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: right;
