<p style="margin: 10pt 0pt 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">In addition, our Restated Certificate of Incorporation restricts certain transfers of our common stock in order to preserve the tax treatment of our net operating loss carryforwards and built-in losses under Section <span id="fs_IVGMVHYTZK00000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">382</span> of the Code. Subject to certain exceptions pertaining to pre-existing <span id="fs_Z3J8AVDZU800000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">5</span>% stockholders and Class&#160;B stockholders, the transfer restrictions in our Restated Certificate of Incorporation generally restrict any direct or indirect transfer (such as transfers of the Company&#8217;s stock that result from the transfer of interests in other entities that own the Company&#8217;s stock) if the effect would be to: (i)&#160;increase the direct or indirect ownership of the Company&#8217;s stock by any person (or public group) from less than <span id="fs_MEWUZWS7I800000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">5</span>% to <span id="fs_FAMRPY8NQ800000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">5</span>% or more of the Company&#8217;s stock; (ii)&#160;increase the percentage of the Company&#8217;s stock owned directly or indirectly by a person (or public group) owning or deemed to own <span id="fs_BL2F7FCHLS00000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">5</span>% or more of the Company&#8217;s stock; or (iii)&#160;create a new &#8220;public group&#8221; (as defined in the applicable U.S. Treasury regulations).</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><br/></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;"><i>We could be adversely impacted by the loss of key management personnel or if we fail to attract and retain qualified personnel. </i></span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">To a significant degree, our future success depends on the efforts of our senior management, many of whom have been with the Company for a significant number of years, and our ability to attract and retain qualified personnel. Our operations could be adversely affected if key members of our senior management leave the Company or if we cannot attract and retain qualified personnel to manage growth in our business.</span></p>
<div><br/></div>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;"><b><a id="item1b" href="#"></a>ITEM <span id="fs_U7N5YWF1UO00000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">1</span>B</b></span></p>
<div style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left;"><a style="text-decoration: none; color: #000000; cursor: default; outline: none; pointer-events: none;" href="#TOC" id="Bs14_911202423824407"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;"><b>UNRESOLVED STAFF COMMENTS</b></span></a></div>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;"><i>None.</i></span></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; color: #000000; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: #ffffff; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;"><b>ITEM <span id="fs_R86G8BKCE800000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">1</span>C</b></span></p>
<div style="margin: 0pt; color: #000000; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: #ffffff; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; text-align: left;"><a style="text-decoration: none; color: #000000; cursor: default; outline: none; pointer-events: none;" href="#TOC" id="Bs15_91120242385295"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;"><b>CYBERSECURITY</b></span></a></div>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;"><br/></p>
<div id="fs_A0XPAGZNF400000000000000000000B"><ix:nonNumeric name="cyd:CybersecurityRiskManagementProcessesForAssessingIdentifyingAndManagingThreatsTextBlock" contextRef="D20251031" escape="true" id="Tag870">
<p style="margin: 0in 0in 12pt; line-height: normal;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'times new roman', times;"><b style="mso-bidi-font-weight: normal;"><i style="mso-bidi-font-style: normal;">Risk Management and Strategy</i></b></span></p>
<p style="margin: 0in 0in 10pt; line-height: 1.2; font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'times new roman', times; text-indent: 45pt;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;"><span id="fs_FN5WOOEDXC00000000000000000000FM"><ix:nonNumeric name="cyd:CybersecurityRiskManagementProcessesIntegratedTextBlock" contextRef="D20251031" escape="true" id="Tag871"><span style="border-left: none; border-right: none;"><span style="-sec-ix-hidden:Tag848">As part of our Enterprise Risk Management function, which is led by our Chief Financial Officer, we have implemented processes to assess, identify and manage material risks facing the Company, including cyber threats.</span></span> In fulfilling his Enterprise Risk Management responsibilities, our Chief Financial Officer collaborates closely with members of senior management and others, including outside experts. Our cybersecurity program maps to standards published by The National Institute of Standards and Technology. We believe that our processes provide us with a comprehensive assessment of potential cyber threats. On a regular basis, we conduct scans, penetration tests and vulnerability assessments of our systems. Our processes to assess, identify and manage the material risks from cyber threats includes risks arising from threats associated with third-party service providers, including cloud-based platforms.</ix:nonNumeric></span></span></p>
<p style="margin: 0in 0in 12pt; text-indent: 45pt; line-height: normal; font-size: 10pt; font-family: Calibri, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'times new roman', times;">We have developed a robust Cybersecurity Incident Response Plan which provides a documented framework for assessing cyber threats, managing high severity security incidents and facilitating coordination across multiple platforms throughout the Company and with outside agencies like the Federal Bureau of Investigation. Our cybersecurity team uses advanced tools to constantly monitor emerging threats and respond to potential cybersecurity incidents. In addition, we periodically perform simulations and drills, including tabletop exercises, aimed at evaluating the Company&#8217;s cybersecurity preparedness. </span></p>
<p style="margin: 0in 0in 12pt; text-indent: 45pt; line-height: normal;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt;">Internally, we have a Cybersecurity Awareness Program which includes annual training that reinforces our information technology and security policies, standards and practices. Our annual training includes education on how to identify potential cybersecurity risks and ways to protect our resources and information. This training is mandatory for all associates on an annual basis, and it is supplemented by testing initiatives, including periodic phishing tests. In addition, we distribute ongoing educational communications, such as newsletters on cybersecurity awareness and hot topics, throughout the year. We also provide additional specialized security training for our cybersecurity&#160;operations team, including attendance at cybersecurity conferences and training seminars, breach simulation exercises and personal accreditation training.</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0in 0in 10pt; text-indent: 45pt; line-height: normal;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="-sec-ix-hidden:Tag849">From time to time, we engage third-party vendors or service providers to enhance our risk mitigation efforts.</span> For instance, <span style="-sec-ix-hidden:Tag850">we have periodically engaged an independent cybersecurity advisor to lead a live&#160;cybersecurity crisis simulation exercise with our senior management to prepare for a possible cybersecurity incident. In addition, we have engaged other outside assessors, consultants and third parties in connection with enhancing our cybersecurity program.</span> We purchase insurance to protect us against the risk of cybersecurity breaches. Our Enterprise Risk Management function, along with our insurance broker, are responsible for our insurance programs and on a consistent basis our cybersecurity insurance policies are reviewed to assess whether we have appropriate coverage. Enterprise Risk Management also presents updates on our cybersecurity liability insurance to our Board of Directors, including industry claims data and benchmarking.</span></p>

<p style="margin: 0in 0in 10pt; text-indent: 45pt; line-height: 1.2; font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'times new roman', times;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'times new roman', times; line-height: inherit;"><span id="fs_QHCX3DC9HC00000000000000000000FM" style="line-height: inherit;"><ix:nonNumeric name="cyd:CybersecurityRiskMateriallyAffectedOrReasonablyLikelyToMateriallyAffectRegistrantTextBlock" contextRef="D20251031" escape="true" id="Tag872"><span style="border-left: none; border-right: none; line-height: inherit;"><span style="-sec-ix-hidden:Tag851">To date, risks from cybersecurity threats have not materially affected us, and we currently do not expect that the risks from cybersecurity threats are reasonably likely to materially affect us, including our business, strategy, results of operations or financial condition.</span></span> </ix:nonNumeric></span>That said, the sophistication of cyber threats continues to increase, and the preventative actions the Company takes to reduce the risk of cyber incidents and protect its systems and information may be insufficient. No matter how well designed or implemented the Company&#8217;s cybersecurity controls are, it will not be able to anticipate all security breaches, and it may not be able to implement effective preventive measures against cybersecurity breaches in a timely manner. See Item <span id="fs_2MM0J09LWG00000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline; line-height: inherit;">1</span>A&#160;<span style="color: #000000; font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: start; text-indent: 36px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important; line-height: inherit;">&#8220;</span>Risk Factors &#8212; Information technology failures and data security breaches could harm our business.<span style="color: #000000; font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: start; text-indent: 36px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important; line-height: inherit;">&#8221;</span></span></p>

<p style="margin: 0in 0in 10pt; line-height: 1.2; break-after: avoid; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'times new roman', times; line-height: inherit;"><b style="mso-bidi-font-weight: normal;">Governance</b></span></p>
<div id="fs_APPJK7X0OG00000000000000000000B"><ix:nonNumeric name="cyd:CybersecurityRiskBoardOfDirectorsOversightTextBlock" contextRef="D20251031" escape="true" id="Tag875">
<p style="margin: 0in 0in 10pt; text-indent: 13.5pt; line-height: 1.2; font-size: 10pt; font-family: Calibri, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'times new roman', times; line-height: inherit;"><b style="mso-bidi-font-weight: normal;"><i style="mso-bidi-font-style: normal;">Role of the Board of Directors</i></b></span></p>
<p style="margin: 0in 0in 10pt; text-indent: 45pt; line-height: 1.2; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">Our Enterprise Risk Management function is part of our Board of Directors&#8217; overall risk management oversight process, which includes regular meetings to identify and evaluate both short and long-term risks and develop plans to manage such risks effectively. <span id="fs_TB6GPH261S00000000000000000000FM" style="line-height: inherit;"><ix:nonNumeric name="cyd:CybersecurityRiskBoardCommitteeOrSubcommitteeResponsibleForOversightTextBlock" contextRef="D20251031" escape="true" id="Tag873">In addition, our Board of Directors established a Cybersecurity Subcommittee of the Corporate Governance and Nominating Committee of the Board of Directors in fiscal <span id="fs_HTWJ3F4F6O00000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline; line-height: inherit;">2018</span> that receives regular updates from our cybersecurity&#160;operations team to assess the primary cybersecurity risks facing the Company, including, among other things,&#160;the status of projects to strengthen our information security systems, results of assessments performed as part of our Cybersecurity&#160;Awareness Program, the measures the Company is taking to mitigate cybersecurity risks and our views of the emerging threat landscape.<span style="line-height: inherit;">&#160;Reports from&#160;</span>outside experts who have been engaged by the Company to review and advise on cybersecurity preparedness are also shared with the Cybersecurity Subcommittee and the Board of Directors. The Cybersecurity Subcommittee regularly reports to the Board of Directors on the oversight work the subcommittee has performed.</ix:nonNumeric></span></span></p>
<div style="border-left: none; border-right: none;">
<div style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; margin: 10pt 0pt 0pt; text-indent: 0pt; line-height: 1.2;">
<div>
<p style="margin: 0in 0in 10pt; text-indent: 45pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;"><span id="fs_4DJM4DPHTC00000000000000000000FM" style="line-height: inherit;"><ix:nonNumeric name="cyd:CybersecurityRiskProcessForInformingBoardCommitteeOrSubcommitteeResponsibleForOversightTextBlock" contextRef="D20251031" escape="true" id="Tag878">Additionally, the Audit Committee of the Board of Directors is responsible for the primary oversight of our Enterprise Risk Management function, which includes an evaluation of cybersecurity risks and threats. In addition to the updates the Cybersecurity Subcommittee provides the Board of Directors, the Board of Directors and Audit Committee receive regular updates from management, including the Chief Information Officer and members of his team, as to changes in our cybersecurity risk profile and/or significant newly identified risks. Our Chief Financial Officer reports directly to both the Audit Committee as well as our Chairman and Chief Executive Officer and is responsible for reporting to each on our Company-wide Enterprise Risk Management function.</ix:nonNumeric></span></span></p>

<p style="margin: 0in 0in 10pt; text-indent: 13.5pt; line-height: normal;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'times new roman', times; line-height: inherit;"><b style="mso-bidi-font-weight: normal;"><i style="mso-bidi-font-style: normal;">Role of Management</i></b></span></p>
<div style="border-left: none; border-right: none;">
<div style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; margin: 10pt 0pt 0pt; text-indent: 0pt; line-height: 1.2;">
<div>
<p style="margin: 0px; text-indent: 45pt; line-height: normal; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;"><span id="fs_HWJP3HV7TC00000000000000000000FM" style="line-height: inherit;"><ix:nonNumeric name="cyd:CybersecurityRiskRoleOfManagementTextBlock" contextRef="D20251031" escape="true" id="Tag877">Our Chief Information Officer, together with our cybersecurity operations team, maintains monitoring&#160;<span id="fs_02EL2STC3K00000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline; line-height: inherit;">24</span>/<span id="fs_M0ANIVUWY800000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline; line-height: inherit;">7</span>&#160;and is responsible for the day-to-day procedures related to&#160;our cybersecurity risks. <span id="fs_000MDQYI4G00000000000000000000FM"><ix:nonNumeric name="cyd:CybersecurityRiskManagementPositionsOrCommitteesResponsibleTextBlock" contextRef="D20251031" escape="true" id="Tag874"><span style="-sec-ix-hidden:Tag852;line-height: inherit;;">We have established an Executive Incident Response Team, which includes our Chief Financial Officer, Chief Information Officer, Vice President, Risk Management, Vice President, General Counsel and other senior officers, which meets at least bi-annually to review our&#160;cybersecurity posture and discuss information security matters.</span> The Executive Incident Response Team has primary oversight responsibility for assessing and managing technology and operational risk, including but not limited to, information security, fraud, vendor, data protection and privacy, business continuity and resilience, and cybersecurity risks.</ix:nonNumeric></span></ix:nonNumeric></span></span></p>

<p style="margin: 0px; text-indent: 0px; font-size: 12pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;"><br/></span></p>
<p style="margin: 0in 0in 10pt; text-indent: 45pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit; font-family: 'times new roman', times;"><span id="fs_1CA6TLK9G000000000000000000000FM"><ix:nonNumeric name="cyd:CybersecurityRiskProcessForInformingManagementOrCommitteesResponsibleTextBlock" contextRef="D20251031" escape="true" id="Tag879">We have a set of policies comprised of coordinated
procedures and tasks that our cybersecurity&#160;operations team, under the
direction of the Chief Information Officer, executes with the goal of
preventing cyber incidents through early detection. In the event there is a cybersecurity
incident, we follow our Cybersecurity Incident Response Plan, which is the
framework designed to help mitigate the impact and ensure a timely and accurate
response. Our cybersecurity framework includes regular assessments to ensure we
are following our internal policies and standards, as well as applicable state
and federal statutes or regulations. In addition, we validate compliance with
our internal data security controls through the use of security monitoring
utilities and internal and external audits.</ix:nonNumeric></span> <span style="-sec-ix-hidden:Tag867">Our Chief Information Officer keeps
our management, Board of Directors, Audit Committee and Cybersecurity
Subcommittee informed about the mitigation and remediation of any cybersecurity
incidents.</span></span></p>

In particular, our Chief Information Officer has <span style="color: #000000; font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: start; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important; line-height: inherit;">over <span id="fs_76E2XQJA7K00000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline; line-height: inherit;">25</span> years of experience managing information technology systems and</span>&#160;<span id="fs_D1FVKBH7QO00000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline; line-height: inherit;">nine</span> years of experience leading cybersecurity initiatives in the information security area.</ix:nonNumeric></span></span></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; color: #000000; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; background-color: #ffffff; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; line-height: 1.2;"><b><span></span>ITEM<span>&#160;</span><span style="cursor: default;">5</span></b></p>
<div style="color: #000000; font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; font-size: 13.3333px; background-color: #ffffff; margin: 0pt;"><a style="text-decoration: none; color: #000000; cursor: default; outline: none; pointer-events: none;" href="#TOC" id="Bs21_911202423111765"><b>MARKET FOR REGISTRANT&#8217;S COMMON EQUITY, RELATED STOCKHOLDER MATTERS, AND ISSUER PURCHASES OF EQUITY SECURITIES</b></a></div>
<p style="margin: 0pt; color: #000000; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; background-color: #ffffff; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; line-height: 1.2;">&#160;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; text-align: left; line-height: 1.2;">The following key performance indicators are commonly used in the homebuilding industry and by management as a means&#160;to better understand our operating performance and trends affecting our business and compare our performance with the performance of other homebuilders. We believe these key performance indicators also provide useful information to investors in analyzing our performance:</p>

<p style="text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2; margin: 10pt 0pt; text-indent: 0pt;"><b>Overview </b></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt 14.7pt 0pt -48pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><i>Market Conditions and Operating Results</i></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; line-height: 1.2;">&#160;</p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;">The demand for new and existing homes is dependent on a variety of demographic and economic factors, including job and wage growth, household formation, consumer confidence, mortgage financing, interest rates, inflation and overall housing affordability.</p>
<p style="margin: 10pt 0in 0in; text-indent: 45pt; line-height: 12pt; font-size: 12pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif;"><span style="font-size: 10.0pt;">From January 2022 to October 2023, 30-year mortgage rates more than doubled. The sharp increase in interest rates, persistently high levels of inflation and doubt about the stability of the economy negatively impacted housing demand beginning in the second half of fiscal <span><span id="fs_1E2C55VZMO00000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">2022</span></span> and into fiscal <span><span id="fs_ORJSKNWXFK00000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">2023</span></span>. During the first quarter of fiscal <span><span id="fs_82ADTSIC4G00000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">2024</span></span>, mortgage rates declined, which had a positive effect on our sales pace. Rates fluctuated for the remainder of fiscal <span id="fs_6CKKX04QIO00000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">2024</span> and throughout fiscal 2025 but still remain persistently high. As a result, affordability generally remains challenging for homebuyers. We have stayed aggressive in our pricing, incentives and concessions in order to align with the current market.</span></p>
<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; text-indent: 45pt; line-height: 1.2; margin: 0pt;"><br/></p>
<p style="margin: 0in 0in 10pt; text-indent: 45pt; line-height: 12pt; font-size: 12pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif;"><span style="font-size: 10.0pt;">We continue to use our increased inventory of quick move-in homes (<span style="color: #000000; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 60px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important;">&#8220;</span>QMI homes<span style="color: #000000; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 60px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important;">&#8221;</span>) to help meet buyers&#8217; needs for more affordable housing in the existing uncertain interest rate environment. The time between contract signing and closing is shorter with a QMI home as compared to a to be built home, which provides customers with more certainty on their mortgage pricing. The availability of QMI homes also allows us to offer mortgage interest rate buydown assistance, which is a tool we offer through our wholly-owned mortgage banking subsidiary (<span style="color: #000000; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 60px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important;">&#8220;</span>K. Hovnanian Mortgage<span style="color: #000000; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 60px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important;">&#8221;</span>), to help ease the impact of higher monthly payments from rising interest rates. We pay the cost of interest rate buydowns for customers that qualify through K. Hovnanian Mortgage and decide to use the program. The level of interest rate based incentives utilized differs across our markets and is <span><span id="fs_7RU8K3WX4W00000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">one</span></span> of several available options we use to drive sales and close homes.</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0in 0in 10pt; text-indent: 45pt; line-height: 12pt; font-size: 12pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; text-indent: 45pt;">















<span style="font-size: 10.0pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman',serif; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-ansi-language: EN-US; mso-fareast-language: EN-US; mso-bidi-language: AR-SA;">Although the long-term fundamentals of
the&#160;new home market remain favorable, during fiscal 2025, volatility in
the broader economy and affordability constraints caused many consumers to
delay purchasing a new home. As a result of this more difficult sales
environment, we experienced a decrease in net&#160;contracts compared to fiscal 2024. Even as mortgage rates increased and we focused on increasing sales
pace versus price, we were still able to raise&#160;net prices in approximately</span></span><span style="font-size: 10pt; text-indent: 45pt;">&#160;<span id="fs_WKDDZTQMSG00000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">36</span>% of our communities during the fourth quarter of fiscal <span id="fs_JEW2NL90RK00000000000000000000FM" style="display: inline;">2025</span>.&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 10pt 0in 0in; text-indent: 45pt; line-height: 12pt; font-size: 12pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif;"><span style="font-size: 10.0pt;">There remains a great degree of
uncertainty due to inflation, tariffs, the continued possibility of an economic
recession, employment risk and the potential for further mortgage rate
increases. While we continue to experience certain supply chain issues, we remain
focused on continuing to shorten our construction cycle times and building on
our national initiatives to drive down costs with our material providers and
trade partners. The changing conditions in the housing market, and in the
general economy, make it difficult to predict how strongly our business will
be impacted by these external factors over fiscal 2026 and
beyond.</span></p>
<p style="margin: 10pt 0pt; text-indent: 45pt; line-height: 12pt; font-size: 12pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif;"><span style="font-size: 10.0pt;"></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-indent: 45pt;">Our cash position allowed us to spend $</span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; text-align: right; text-indent: 0px; float: none; display: inline !important;"><span id="fs_Y28H1LQHWG00000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">859.4</span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-indent: 45pt;">&#160;million on land purchases and land development for long-term growth during fiscal </span><span id="fs_T8798HEDI800000000000000000000fs" style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-indent: 45pt;">2025</span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-indent: 45pt;">&#160;and still have total liquidity of $</span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; text-align: right; text-indent: 0px; float: none; display: inline !important;"><span id="fs_8MRIIAFNS000000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">404.1</span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-indent: 45pt;">&#160;million, including $</span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-indent: 45pt; border-left: none; border-right: none;"><span id="fs_AQ286HEGCW00000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">272.8</span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-ansi-language: EN-US; mso-fareast-language: EN-US; mso-bidi-language: AR-SA;">In addition, our September 2025 issuance of $900.0

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 81pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;">&#9679; For the year ended <span id="fs_VKFO2P0VOW00000000000000000000FM">October 31, 2025</span>, sale of homes revenues <span id="fs_SAZT013N4W00000000000000000000FM">decreased</span> <span id="fs_FWRVKEYTWG00000000000000000000fs">0.8</span>% as compared to the prior year, due to a 3.5% decrease in average sales prices, partially offset by a <span style="color: #000000; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: right; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important;"><span id="fs_ZXR2GE1UOG00000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">2.8</span></span>% increase in homes delivered. <p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 81pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;">&#9679; Earnings per share, basic and diluted, decreased to $<span id="fs_HPVXG2Y47400000000000000000000fs">7.95</span> and $<span id="fs_Q62MMQUV1S00000000000000000000fs">7.43</span>, respectively,&#160;for the year ended&#160;<span id="fs_5UABWYFEBK00000000000000000000FM">October 31, 2025</span>, compared to earnings&#160;per share, basic and diluted&#160;of $<span style="color: #000000; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important; line-height: inherit;"><span id="fs_K6NVKVPC3400000000000000000000fs">34.40</span></span> and $<span style="color: #000000; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important; line-height: inherit;"><span id="fs_NC5QOZDGWW00000000000000000000fs">31.79</span></span>, respectively, for the year ended&#160;<span id="fs_O5B5NYHWIO00000000000000000000FM">October 31, 2024</span>.</p>
<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 81pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;">&#160;</p>
<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 81pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;">&#9679; Net contracts decreased <span style="color: #000000; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important;"><span id="fs_NUC1O6F7S000000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">3.1</span></span>% to <span style="border-left: none; border-right: none;"><span id="fs_G9UTRF1UI800000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">5,023</span></span> for the year ended <span id="fs_GGJQ01SN4000000000000000000000FM">October 31, 2025</span>, compared to <span id="fs_XDNZI4SW0000000000000000000000FM" style="display: inline;">5,186</span>&#160;in the prior year. Included in the year ended <span id="fs_SR18HMIIEO00000000000000000000FM">October 31, 2025</span>&#160;and <span id="fs_EHFD0R5JK000000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">2024</span>, respectively, were <span style="border-left: none; border-right: none;"><span id="fs_VVIJU67SW000000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">44</span></span>&#160;and&#160;<span style="color: #000000; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important;"><span id="fs_OZOZ81D3OG00000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">276</span></span>&#160;build-for-rent contracts.</p>
<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 81pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;">&#160;</p>
<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 81pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;">&#9679; Net contracts per active selling community decreased to&#160;<span id="fs_ADFRBBPDS000000000000000000000FM">35.9</span>&#160;for the year ended <span id="fs_657EZ5WMBK00000000000000000000FM">October 31, 2025</span> compared to&#160;<span style="color: #000000; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important; line-height: inherit;"><span id="fs_GWRX74V44000000000000000000000fs">39.9</span></span> in the prior year. The decrease was due to the decrease in net contracts from October 31, 2024 to October 31, 2025.</p>
<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 81pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><br/></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 81pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;">&#9679; Active selling communities increased to <span style="border-left: none; border-right: none;"><span id="fs_WME9LMKYPC00000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">140</span></span> at <span id="fs_K5SI4WSRFK00000000000000000000FM">October 31, 2025</span> compared to&#160;<span style="color: #000000; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important;"><span id="fs_A37MX01H7400000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">130</span></span>&#160;at <span id="fs_YHTYI6OZG000000000000000000000FM">October 31, 2024</span>, while our total lots controlled decreased to <span style="border-left: none; border-right: none;"><span id="fs_WOJ5EH8BOG00000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">35,883</span></span> at <span id="fs_J7T8KW03N400000000000000000000FM">October 31, 2025</span> compared to&#160;<span style="color: #000000; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; This reduction in the number of total lots controlled was primarily the result&#160;<span style="font-size: 10.0pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman',serif; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-ansi-language: EN-US; mso-fareast-language: EN-US; mso-bidi-language: AR-SA;">of our decision to walk away from certain lower
margin lots. These lots had been originally underwritten prior to the escalation

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 81pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;">&#9679; Contract backlog decreased from&#160;<span style="color: #000000; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important;"><span id="fs_HZ14955YDS00000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">1,649</span></span>&#160;homes at <span id="fs_LL4WCE5IFK00000000000000000000FM">October 31, 2024</span> to <span style="border-left: none; border-right: none;"><span id="fs_PIHPT10VXS00000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">1,242</span></span> homes at <span id="fs_EIFC9B9UTC00000000000000000000FM">October 31, 2025</span>, and the dollar value of contract backlog decreased to $<span style="border-left: none; border-right: none;"><span id="fs_7DOU87EDWG00000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">726.5</span></span>&#160;million, a <span style="border-left: none; border-right: none;"><span id="fs_DQBEXRD7IO00000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">22.4</span></span>% decrease in dollar value compared to the prior year. Our backlog conversion ratio has increased from the prior year due to our focus on having more QMI homes available to sell and deliver.&#160;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><i><b>Homebuilding: Sale of Homes</b></i></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&#160;</p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Sale of homes revenues <span id="fs_E5YO8GL7WW00000000000000000000FM">decreased</span> $<span id="fs_2OQGLADWCG00000000000000000000fs">22.6</span> million, or <span id="fs_MY234F45J400000000000000000000fs">0.8</span>%, for the year ended <span id="fs_R7UFUR94EO00000000000000000000FM">October 31, 2025</span>, compared to the prior year. The slight decrease in revenues in fiscal <span id="fs_GYEMO64AKW00000000000000000000fs">2025</span> was&#160;primarily due to the&#160;<span style="color: #000000; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; <p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&#160;</p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Land sales and other revenues <span id="fs_ON1J1MGZEO00000000000000000000FM">decreased</span> $<span id="fs_B1WG0OYHRK00000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">24.7</span> million for the year ended <span id="fs_I89R72VU1S00000000000000000000FM">October 31, 2025</span>, compared to the prior year.&#160;<span style="color: #000000; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 60px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important;">Revenue associated with land sales can vary significantly due to the mix of land parcels sold. <p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><i><b>Homebuilding: Cost of Sales</b></i></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&#160;</p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Cost of sales includes expenses for consolidated housing and land and lot sales, including inventory impairment and land option write-offs (defined as &#8220;land charges&#8221; in the tables below). A breakout of such expenses for homebuilding and land and lot sales and the gross margins for each is set forth below.</p>
<p style="margin: 0pt 15pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 42.9pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&#160;</p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Homebuilding gross margin before cost of sales interest expense and land charges, is a non-GAAP financial measure. This measure should not be considered as an alternative to homebuilding gross margin determined in accordance with U.S. GAAP as an indicator of operating performance.</p>
<p style="margin: 0pt 22.5pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 46.2pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&#160;</p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Management believes this non-GAAP measure enables&#160;investors to better&#160;understand our operating performance. This measure is also useful internally, helping management evaluate our operating results on a consolidated basis and relative to other companies in our industry. In particular, the magnitude and volatility of land charges for the Company, and for other homebuilders, have been significant and, as such, have made comparable financial analysis of our industry more difficult. Homebuilding metrics excluding land charges, as well as interest amortized to cost of sales, and other similar presentations prepared by analysts and other companies are frequently used to assist investors in understanding and comparing the operating characteristics of homebuilding activities by eliminating many of the differences in companies&#8217; respective levels of impairments and debt.</p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&#160;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&#160;</p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">We sell a variety of home types in various communities, each yielding a different gross margin.&#160;As a result, depending on the mix of communities delivering homes, consolidated gross margin may fluctuate up or down.&#160;Total homebuilding gross margin percentage decreased to 12.7% for the year ended <span id="fs_CKEL1RXNGG00000000000000000000FM">October 31, 2025</span> compared to <span style="color: #000000; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 60px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important; line-height: inherit;"><span id="fs_R7Q4VR169S00000000000000000000fs">18.7</span></span>% for the prior year. Total homebuilding gross margin percentage, before cost of sales interest expense and land charges decreased to 17.2% for the year ended <span id="fs_RJL4U6FXIO00000000000000000000FM">October 31, 2025</span> compared to <span style="color: #000000; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 60px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important; line-height: inherit;"><span id="fs_D2EL5BTFJ400000000000000000000fs">22.0</span></span>% for the prior year. The decreases in gross margins were&#160;primarily due to increases in our use of incentives and concessions, including additional mortgage interest rate buydowns, to make our homes more affordable.</p>

<p style="margin: 8pt 0pt 9pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Land sales are ancillary to our homebuilding operations and are expected to continue in the future but may fluctuate significantly.</p>
<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 9pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; text-indent: 0pt;"><i><b>Homebuilding: Inventory Impairments and Land Option Write-offs</b></i></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; text-indent: 45pt;">Inventory impairments and land option write-offs reflect certain inventories we have either written off or written down to their estimated fair value totaling $<span style="border-left: none; border-right: none;"><span id="fs_MA4MTJHAKG00000000000000000000FM" style="display: inline;">39.6</span></span> million and $<span style="color: #000000; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: start; text-indent: 60px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important; line-height: inherit;"><span id="fs_XJBKWTDGNK00000000000000000000fs">11.6</span></span> million in expense for the years ended <span id="fs_ABGRXPONQ800000000000000000000FM">October 31, 2025</span> and <span id="fs_VQCDQ46WWW00000000000000000000fs">2024</span>, respectively. During the years ended <span id="fs_ROLN5287XC00000000000000000000FM">October 31, 2025</span> and <span id="fs_HBR1NQE6RK00000000000000000000fs">2024</span>, we wrote off residential land option, approval and engineering costs totaling $<span style="border-left: none; border-right: none;"><span id="fs_ZU6I4GWVUO00000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">18.2</span></span> million and $<span style="color: #000000; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: start; text-indent: 60px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important;"><span id="fs_3SUL833ABK00000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">1.6</span></span>&#160;million, respectively. Land option, approval and engineering costs are written off when a community&#8217;s pro forma profitability is not projected to produce an adequate return on investment commensurate with the risk. If we determine an adequate return is not probable, we cancel the option, or when a community is redesigned, we write off the engineering costs related to the initial design. Such write-offs occurred across each of our segments in fiscal <span id="fs_OLNTHVTSC000000000000000000000fs">2025</span> and <span id="fs_TCGDJLCYCG00000000000000000000fs">2024</span>. Inventory impairments were $<span id="fs_A5N3I60BLS00000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">21.4</span> million in the aggregate for the year ended October 31, 2025 for <span id="fs_D21LSU2BCW00000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">six</span> communities in our Northeast segment, <span id="fs_5PBMFRV9WG00000000000000000000FM">one</span> community in our Southeast segment and <span id="fs_MITXXQP12O00000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">five</span>&#160;communities in our West segment. For the year ended October 31, 2024, inventory impairments were $<span id="fs_ZFNXRB68M800000000000000000000FM" style="display: inline;">10.0</span>&#160;million in the aggregate for <span id="fs_IE7CO81IWW00000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">two</span> communities in our Northeast segment and <span id="fs_4L3XR27IK000000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">two</span> communities in our West segment.&#160;It is difficult to predict future impairments, but if conditions in the overall housing industry or a specific geographic market worsen in the future, there are future changes in our business strategy that significantly affect the key assumptions used in our projections of future cash flows, and/or there are material changes in any other items we consider in assessing recoverability, we may need to recognize additional inventory impairments and any such charges could be material.</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&#160;&#160;</p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><i><b>Homebuilding: Selling, General and Administrative</b></i></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt 7.5pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b>&#160;</b></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Homebuilding selling, general and administrative (&#8220;SGA&#8221;) expenses increased $<span style="border-left: none; border-right: none;"><span id="fs_077UPXRTXS00000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">9.9</span></span>&#160;million to $<span style="border-left: none; border-right: none;"><span id="fs_DQK627SAR400000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">212.4</span></span>&#160;million for the year ended <span id="fs_XUNK0YJCXS00000000000000000000FM">October 31, 2025</span>, compared to the prior fiscal year. The increase is primarily due to an increase in selling overhead from higher advertising costs and an increase in total compensation expense as a result of an increase in headcount from opening more communities along with the cost associated with annual merit increases, as well as fees incurred on unused builder forward commitments we began offering in the second half of fiscal 2022 to lower mortgage rates for our customers.</p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&#160;</p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b>Homebuilding: Key Performance Indicators</b></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&#160;</p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><i>Net Contracts Per Active Selling Community</i></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&#160;</p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Net contracts per active selling community in fiscal <span id="fs_VZECRR3IB400000000000000000000fs">2025</span> were 35.9 compared to&#160;<span style="color: #000000; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 60px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important; line-height: inherit;"><span id="fs_FPSARHGMGG00000000000000000000fs">39.9</span></span> in fiscal <span id="fs_WQDSBVD0W000000000000000000000fs">2024</span>, a 10.0% <span id="fs_V4IYTX8TUO00000000000000000000FM">decrease</span>&#160;in sales pace per community. Our reported level of sales contracts (net of cancellations) was impacted by uneven demand caused by overall market uncertainty along with affordability constraints and high interest rates.</p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&#160;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 15pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&#160;</p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt -1pt; text-indent: 45pt;">Most cancellations occur within the legal rescission period, which varies by state but is generally less than <span id="fs_KRT3KRTMPS00000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">two</span> weeks after the&#160;signing of the contract. Cancellations also occur as a result of a buyer&#8217;s failure to qualify for a mortgage, which generally occurs during the first&#160;few weeks after signing. Due to our solid backlog position, our cancellation rate as a percentage of beginning backlog for the fourth quarter of&#160;fiscal <span id="fs_1DAN1D73WW00000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">2025</span> was <span id="fs_XAGKMTB5R400000000000000000000FM" style="display: inline;">17</span>%, which approximates our historical normal rate. When sales pace is increasing, the cancellation rate as a percentage of&#160;beginning backlog tends to lag the changes seen in our cancellation rate as a percentage of gross sales. Market conditions, although continuing to improve, still remain uncertain and it is difficult to predict what cancellation rates will be in the future.</p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&#160;</p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><i>Contract Backlog</i></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&#160;</p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Our consolidated contract backlog, excluding unconsolidated joint ventures, by segment is set forth below:</p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&#160;</p>
<div id="t_ft_DL8DWME4G000000000000000000000b">
<table class="finTable" style="width: 100%; font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'times new roman'; text-indent: 0px; height: 238px;" border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0">
<tbody>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&#160;</p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><i><b>Homebuilding Results by Segment</b></i></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b>&#160;</b></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><i>Northeast</i> &#8211;
















<span style="font-size: 10.0pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman',serif; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-font-kerning: 0pt; mso-ligatures: none; mso-ansi-language: EN-US; mso-fareast-language: EN-US; mso-bidi-language: AR-SA;">Homebuilding
revenues increased 11.2% in fiscal 2025&#160;compared to fiscal 2024, primarily
due to a <span style="color: #000000;">19.6</span>% increase in homes delivered,
partially offset by a 4.8% decrease in average sales&#160;price. The decrease
in average sales price was the result of new communities delivering lower
priced, smaller single family homes, townhomes and affordable-housing homes&#160;in fiscal 2025 compared to some
communities delivering higher priced, larger single family homes and townhomes
in higher-end submarkets of the segment in fiscal 2024, which were no longer
delivered in fiscal 2025.</span>&#160;</p>
<p style="margin: 0in; font-size: 12pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif;"><span style="font-size: 10.0pt;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="text-indent: 45pt; line-height: 12pt; margin: 0in; font-size: 12pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif;"><span style="font-size: 10.0pt;">Income before income taxes decreased $25.5&#160;million
to $<span style="color: #000000;">165.5</span>&#160;million in fiscal
2025&#160;compared to fiscal 2024, primarily due to a $23.6 million decrease in land sales
and other revenue, an $11.5 million increase in inventory impairments and land
option write-offs and a decrease in gross margin percentage.&#160;<span style="font-size: 10.0pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman',serif; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-ansi-language: EN-US; mso-fareast-language: EN-US; mso-bidi-language: AR-SA;">For a discussion of gross margin, see
&#8220;Homebuilding: Cost of Sales&#8221; above.</span>


</span></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;">&#160;</p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><i>Southeast</i> &#8211;&#160;<span style="font-size: 10.0pt;">Homebuilding revenues decreased 22.0% in fiscal
2025&#160;compared to fiscal 2024, primarily due to a <span style="color: #000000;">19.8</span>%
decrease in homes delivered and a 2.7% decrease in average sales price. The
decrease in average sales price was the result of new communities delivering
lower priced, smaller single family homes in lower-end submarkets of the
segment in fiscal 2025 compared to some communities in fiscal 2024 that had
higher priced, larger single family homes and townhomes in higher-end
submarkets, which were no longer delivered in fiscal 2025.</span></p>
<p style="text-indent: 45pt; line-height: 12pt; margin: 0in; font-size: 12pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif;"><span style="font-size: 10.0pt;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="text-indent: 45pt; line-height: 12pt; margin: 0in; font-size: 12pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif;"><span style="font-size: 10.0pt;">Income before income taxes decreased $62.2&#160;million
to $<span style="color: #000000;">15.5</span>&#160;million in fiscal
2025&#160;compared to fiscal 2024, primarily due to the decrease in
homebuilding revenue discussed above, a $4.8 million increase in inventory
impairments and land option write-offs and a decrease in gross
margin percentage.&#160;<span style="font-size: 10.0pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman',serif; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-ansi-language: EN-US; mso-fareast-language: EN-US; mso-bidi-language: AR-SA;">For a discussion of gross margin, see
&#8220;Homebuilding: Cost of Sales&#8221; above.</span>


</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; text-indent: 45pt;">&#160;</p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; text-indent: 45pt;"><i>West</i> &#8211;&#160;<span style="font-size: 10.0pt;">Homebuilding revenues decreased 4.2% in fiscal
2025&#160;compared to fiscal 2024 due a 4.5% decrease in average
sales price, while the numbers of homes delivered remained flat. The decrease
in average sales price was mainly the result of new communities delivering
lower priced, smaller single family homes in lower-end and higher-end submarkets
of the segment in fiscal 2025 compared to some communities in fiscal 2024 that
had higher priced, larger single family homes in higher-end submarkets, which
were no longer delivered in fiscal 2025.</span></p>
<p style="text-indent: 45pt; line-height: 12pt; margin: 0in; font-size: 12pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif;"><span style="font-size: 10.0pt;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="text-indent: 45pt; line-height: 12pt; margin: 0in; font-size: 12pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif;"><span style="font-size: 10.0pt;">Income before income taxes decreased $111.6 million to
$<span style="color: #000000;">15.1</span>&#160;million in fiscal
2025&#160;compared to fiscal 2024, primarily due to the decrease in
homebuilding revenue discussed above, an $11.7 million increase in inventory
impairments and land option write-offs, a $12.4 million increase in SGA expenses and a decrease in gross margin percentage.&#160;<span style="font-size: 10.0pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman',serif; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-ansi-language: EN-US; mso-fareast-language: EN-US; mso-bidi-language: AR-SA;">For a discussion of gross margin, see
&#8220;Homebuilding: Cost of Sales&#8221; above.</span>


</span></p>
