<p style="margin: 10pt 0pt 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; text-indent: 0pt;"><i>Financial Services</i></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&#160;&#160;</p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Financial services consists primarily of originating mortgages for our home buyers, selling such mortgages in the secondary market, and title insurance activities. We use mandatory investor commitments and forward sales of mortgage-backed securities (<span style="color: #000000; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 60px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important;">&#8220;</span>MBS<span style="color: #000000; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 60px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important;">&#8221;</span>) to hedge our mortgage-related interest rate exposure on agency and government loans. These instruments involve, to varying degrees, elements of credit and interest rate risk. Credit risk associated with MBS forward commitments and loan sales transactions is managed by limiting our counterparties to investment banks, federally regulated bank affiliates and other investors meeting our credit standards. Our risk, in the event of default by the purchaser, is the difference between the contract price and fair value of the MBS forward commitments. For the years ended <span id="fs_PC23W2H5PC00000000000000000000FM">October 31, 2025</span> and <span id="fs_7T8A7NWEDC00000000000000000000fs">2024</span>, our conforming conventional loan originations as a percentage of our total loans were&#160;<span style="border-left: none; border-right: none;"><span id="fs_V0IN8U9T4W00000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">58.7</span></span>% and <span style="color: #000000; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 60px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important;"><span id="fs_CUF439NF0000000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">64.0</span></span>%, respectively. FHA/VA loans represented <span style="border-left: none; border-right: none;"><span id="fs_K2LZRF5IDS00000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">40.3</span></span>% and <span style="color: #000000; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 60px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important;"><span id="fs_XXC0D751K000000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">35.4</span></span>%, respectively, of our total loans. The remaining&#160;<span style="border-left: none; border-right: none;"><span id="fs_ERVIVHYCBK00000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">1.0</span></span>% and <span style="color: #000000; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 60px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important;"><span id="fs_1BGID2GJWG00000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">0.6</span></span>% of our loan originations represent loans which exceed conforming conventions. Realized gains and losses relating to the sale of mortgage loans are recognized when control passes to the buyer of the mortgage.</p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&#160;</p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">During the years ended <span id="fs_QHJ7DBO2F400000000000000000000FM">October 31, 2025</span> and <span id="fs_TF4P991EJK00000000000000000000fs">2024</span>, financial services provided $39.0 million and $<span style="color: #000000; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 60px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important; line-height: inherit;"><span id="fs_297J2NIUMO00000000000000000000fs">24.1</span></span> million of income before income taxes, respectively. In fiscal <span id="fs_SV23CKP2LS00000000000000000000fs">2025</span>, financial services income before income taxes increased&#160;from the prior year primarily due to an increase in the volume of loans closed and an increase in the basis point spread between the loans originated&#160;and the implied rate from our sale of the loans. In the markets served by our wholly owned mortgage banking subsidiaries, <span style="border-left: none; border-right: none;"><span id="fs_GUVCA0T7TS00000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">80.0</span></span>% and <span style="color: #000000; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 60px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important;"><span id="fs_VU0ZO7ELZ400000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">79.4</span></span>% of our noncash home buyers obtained mortgages originated by these subsidiaries during the years ended <span id="fs_O4J4CR48EO00000000000000000000FM">October 31, 2025</span> and <span id="fs_WBZ4HTT74000000000000000000000fs">2024</span>, respectively.</p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;">&#160;</p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><i>Corporate General and Administrative</i></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&#160;</p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Corporate general and administrative expenses include payroll, stock compensation, facility costs and rent and other costs associated with our executive offices, legal expenses, information services, human resources, corporate accounting, training, treasury, process redesign, internal audit, national and digital marketing, construction services and administration of insurance, quality and safety. Corporate general and administrative expenses decreased $2.3 million for the year ended <span id="fs_NDU070RYJ400000000000000000000FM">October 31, 2025</span> compared to the year ended <span id="fs_TG5EM6MYWW00000000000000000000FM">October 31, 2024</span>, primarily due to lower stock compensation expense, along with a decrease in bonus expense due to lower profitability. In addition, we recorded&#160;a benefit in fiscal 2025 related to our 2024 and 2023 long-term incentive plan phantom stock awards, as a result of a decrease in our stock price during fiscal 2025.&#160;</p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&#160;</p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><i>Other Interest</i></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&#160;</p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Other interest <span id="fs_E0X3UU8ZQ800000000000000000000FM">increased</span> $<span id="fs_D2TSGY54EO00000000000000000000fs">4.7</span> million to $<span style="color: #000000; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 60px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important; line-height: inherit;"><span id="fs_Z9H9QQNEWW00000000000000000000fs">35.4</span></span> million for the year ended <span id="fs_I9RO0YH1PC00000000000000000000FM">October 31, 2025</span> compared to the year ended <span id="fs_FM7JQ1CWE800000000000000000000FM">October 31, 2024</span>. The increase in Other&#160;interest was primarily due to an increase in communities in planning, along with additional inventory financing resulting from an <span style="color: #000000; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important;">increase in average land banking and model lease financing interest, as our inventory not owned increased during fiscal 2025.</span></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt;">&#160;</p>
<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 10pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; text-indent: 0pt;"><i>(Loss) Gain on Extinguishment of Debt, Net</i><i></i></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 10pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; text-indent: 0pt;"><i><span style="color: #000000; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 60px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important;">&#160; &#160; &#160; &#160; &#160; &#160; &#160; &#160; &#160; On <span id="fs_3MXMOY3IE800000000000000000000FM">April 30, 2025</span>, K. <p style="margin: 10pt 0pt 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; text-indent: 45pt;">On <span id="fs_HB0Y86UL3400000000000000000000FM">November 15, 2023</span>, we redeemed in full all of the $<span style="display: inline;" id="fs_H9ZQK7UZ4G00000000000000000000FM">113.5</span> million aggregate principal amount of our&#160;<span style="display: inline;" id="fs_N1BL4OIBZ400000000000000000000FM">10.0</span>% Senior Secured <span style="display: inline;" id="fs_57NYIGTLQO00000000000000000000FM">1.75</span> Lien Notes due <span style="display: inline;" id="fs_92VBR0GNN400000000000000000000FM">2025</span> for a redemption price of $<span style="display: inline;" id="fs_P7ICI0IJ4G00000000000000000000FM">119.2</span> million, which included accrued and unpaid interest. <p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; text-indent: 45pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; text-indent: 45pt;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><i>Income&#160;from Unconsolidated Joint Ventures</i></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&#160;</p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Income from unconsolidated joint ventures consists of our share of the income or loss from our joint ventures. Income from unconsolidated joint ventures <span id="fs_SOV6VHKG5C00000000000000000000FM">decreased</span> to $<span style="border-left: none; border-right: none;"><span id="fs_QZKJYAJX3400000000000000000000FM">46.4</span></span> million for the year ended <span id="fs_U41MJDI9Y800000000000000000000FM">October 31, 2025</span> from $<span style="color: #000000; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 60px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important; line-height: inherit;"><span id="fs_BEAHBMGN6800000000000000000000fs">52.3</span></span> million for the year ended <span id="fs_Q73HXCUG8W00000000000000000000FM">October 31, 2024</span>. The decrease of $<span id="fs_7K4BTQJD0W00000000000000000000fs">5.8</span> million in fiscal <span id="fs_7BYRO2GEN400000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">2025</span>&#160;was primarily due to the recognition of losses from two unconsolidated joint ventures in which one started delivering homes during the second quarter of fiscal 2025 and the other is not yet delivering homes. In addition, we recognized income during the first nine months of the prior year from a joint venture that was subsequently consolidated prior to the end of fiscal 2024.</p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&#160;</p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><i>Income Taxes</i></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&#160;</p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Income tax expense decreased to $<span id="fs_GJS3OG2FI800000000000000000000FM" style="display: inline;">22.2</span> million&#160;for the year ended <span id="fs_QK2OF1UTVK00000000000000000000FM">October 31, 2025</span>&#160;from $75.1 million for the year ended October 31,&#160;<span id="fs_PME5O9H1VK00000000000000000000fs">2024</span>.&#160;<span style="font-size: 10.0pt; mso-bidi-font-size: 12.0pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman',serif; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; color: black; mso-ansi-language: EN-US; mso-fareast-language: EN-US; mso-bidi-language: AR-SA;">These amounts were primarily attributable to federal and state taxes on
income before taxes and non-deductible executive compensation, along with less state net operating losses&#160;<span style="color: #000000; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 60px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important;">(&#8220;NOL&#8221;) available to utilize</span>, partially offset by energy efficient home
tax credits. In fiscal <span id="fs_M3LN2D9GMO00000000000000000000FM" style="display: inline;">2025</span>, income tax expense was further reduced by the
benefit of our debt extinguishment.&#160;</span>Income tax expense for fiscal year&#160;<span id="fs_O2GSJ1EFCW00000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">2024</span>&#160;includes the favorable impact of releasing state valuation allowances. Currently, federal tax expense is not paid in cash as it is offset by the use of our existing NOL carryforwards.</p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;">&#160;</p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Deferred federal and state income tax assets (<span style="color: #000000; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 60px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important;">&#8220;</span>DTAs<span style="color: #000000; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 60px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important;">&#8221;</span>) primarily represent the deferred tax benefits arising from NOL carryforwards and temporary differences between book and tax income which will be recognized in subsequent years as an offset against future taxable income. If the combination of future years&#8217; income (or loss) and the reversal of the timing differences results in a loss, such losses can be carried forward to future years. In accordance with ASC <span style="border-left: none; border-right: none;"><span id="fs_Q5ZCNARQYO00000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">740</span></span>, we evaluate our DTAs quarterly to determine if valuation allowances are required. We assess whether valuation allowances should be established based on the consideration of all available evidence using a &#8220;more-likely-than-not&#8221; standard.</p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&#160;</p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">As of <span id="fs_PR8BICQDJ400000000000000000000FM">October 31, 2025</span>, we considered the weight of all available positive and negative evidence to determine the valuation allowance for DTAs of $<span id="fs_NA8ZH8004W00000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">53.0</span> million. See Note <span style="border-left: none; border-right: none;"><span id="fs_VW03CGJH7K00000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">11</span></span> to the Consolidated Financial Statements included elsewhere in this Annual Report on Form 10-K for further information.</p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&#160;</p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Deferred tax assets, net, of $<span id="fs_18JTP7LRTC00000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">229.6</span> million at <span id="fs_45QGREELW000000000000000000000FM">October 31, 2025</span> decreased $<span id="fs_A9YL0G8TCG00000000000000000000FM" style="display: inline;">11.4</span> million from <span id="fs_9JSJJZI0Y800000000000000000000FM">October 31, 2024</span>, due primarily to the utilization of our DTAs to offset tax expense on taxable income during fiscal <span id="fs_PZR6D0RV7K00000000000000000000fs">2025</span>.</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&#160;</p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b>Capital Resources and Liquidity</b></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&#160;</p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><i>Overview </i></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&#160;</p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Our total liquidity at&#160;<span id="fs_FTD3G7LDY800000000000000000000FM">October 31, 2025</span> was $<span id="fs_FUFSIEGY7400000000000000000000FM" style="display: inline;">404.1</span> million, including $<span style="border-left: none; border-right: none;"><span id="fs_2KQDF5J6TS00000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">272.8</span></span> million in homebuilding cash and cash equivalents&#160;and $<span style="color: #000000; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 60px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important; line-height: inherit;"><span id="fs_OTJ73UH10000000000000000000000fs">125.0</span></span> million of borrowing capacity under our senior secured revolving credit facility. This was&#160;above our target liquidity range of $<span style="border-left: none; border-right: none;"><span id="fs_XWPYNUIL7K00000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">170.0</span></span>&#160;to $<span id="fs_K4R24GGI0W00000000000000000000FM" style="display: inline;">245.0</span> million. We believe that our cash on hand together with available&#160;borrowings on our senior secured revolving credit facility&#160;will be sufficient&#160;through fiscal <span id="fs_GNW59DTNYO00000000000000000000FM" style="display: inline;">2026</span>&#160;to finance our working capital requirements.</p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&#160;</p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">We have historically funded our homebuilding and financial services operations with cash flows from operating activities, borrowings under our credit facilities, the issuance of new debt and equity securities, and other financing activities. We may not be able to obtain desired financing even if market conditions, including then-current market available interest rates (in recent years, we have not been able to access the traditional capital and bank lending markets at competitive interest rates due to our highly leveraged capital structure), would otherwise be favorable, which could also impact our ability to grow our business.&#160;</p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;">&#160;</p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><i>Operating, Investing and Financing Cash Flow Activities</i></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&#160;</p>
<p style="margin: 0pt 14.7pt 0pt -3pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">We spent $<span style="color: #000000; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 60px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important;"><span id="fs_86AM5ZIM6800000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">859.4</span></span>&#160;million on land and land development during&#160;fiscal <span id="fs_ILYJOA0QGW00000000000000000000fs">2025</span>. After land and land development spending and all other operating activities, including revenue received from deliveries, we had $<span style="color: #000000; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 60px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important;"><span id="fs_K588CJCSY800000000000000000000fs">188.3</span></span> million in cash provided by operations. During fiscal <span id="fs_U0BV8PI6ZK00000000000000000000fs">2025</span>,&#160;cash used in investing activities was $<span style="color: #000000; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 60px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important;"><span id="fs_Y8LT2BMJGG00000000000000000000fs">66.0</span></span> million, primarily due to a new joint venture entered into during the period, along with spending on capitalized software, partially offset by distributions of capital from existing unconsolidated joint ventures. Cash used in&#160;financing activities was $<span style="color: #000000; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 60px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important;"><span id="fs_FZI0NDXQJ400000000000000000000fs">70.4</span></span> million during fiscal <span id="fs_9SSJRMWCCW00000000000000000000fs">2025</span>, which was primarily due to a $<span style="color: #000000; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 60px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important;"><span id="fs_MKOH8EHA8W00000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">26.6</span></span>&#160;million redemption of our senior secured notes, net payments related to the September 2025 debt transaction and related deferred financing costs, net payments for nonrecourse mortgage financings, treasury stock purchases, payments of preferred dividends and net payments under our mortgage warehouse lines of credit, partially offset by net proceeds from land banking financings and model sale leaseback financings. We intend to continue to use nonrecourse mortgages, model sale leasebacks, joint ventures, and, subject to covenant restrictions in our debt instruments, land banking programs as our business needs dictate.</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 14.7pt 0pt -3pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;">Our cash uses during&#160;the years ended <span style="line-height: inherit;" id="fs_3F747L41OW00000000000000000000FM">October 31, 2025</span> and <span style="line-height: inherit;" id="fs_14IY123IZK00000000000000000000fs">2024</span> were for operating expenses, land purchases, land deposits, land development, construction spending, debt payments, model sale leasebacks, land banking transactions, state income taxes, interest payments, preferred dividend payments, financing transaction costs, debt and equity repurchases, litigation matters and investments in unconsolidated joint ventures.&#160;During these periods, we provided for our cash requirements from available cash on hand, home and land sales, financing transactions, nonrecourse mortgage transactions, income from unconsolidated joint ventures, financial service revenues and other revenues.<br/></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt 14.7pt 0pt -3pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><br/></p>



























































</div><div style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt;" id="Dnls76zfmof0c3igeyj860j">
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; line-height: inherit;">Our net income historically does not approximate cash flow from operating activities. The difference between net income and cash flow from operating activities is primarily caused by changes in inventory levels together with changes in receivables, prepaid expenses and other assets, mortgage loans held for sale, accrued interest, deferred income taxes, accounts payable and other liabilities, and noncash charges relating to depreciation, stock compensation and impairments. When we are expanding our operations, inventory levels, prepaid expenses and other assets increase causing cash flow from operating activities to decrease. Certain liabilities also increase as operations expand and partially offset the negative effect on cash flow from operations caused by the increase in inventory, prepaid expenses and other assets. Similarly, as our mortgage operations expand, net income from these operations increases, but for cash flow purposes, net income is partially offset by the net change in mortgage assets and liabilities. The opposite is true as our investment in new land purchases and development of new communities decrease, causing us to generate positive cash flow from operations.&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times;">See &#8220;Inventories&#8221; below for a detailed discussion of our inventory position.</span></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; text-indent: 45pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; line-height: inherit;">On September 1, 2022, our Board of Directors (the <span style="color: #000000; font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 60px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important;">&#8220;</span>Board<span style="color: #000000; font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 60px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important;">&#8221;</span>) authorized a repurchase program for up to $<span style="line-height: inherit; display: inline;" id="fs_H24NY68EWG00000000000000000000fs">50.0</span> million of our Class A common stock. <span style="color: #000000; font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 60px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important;">On December 18, 2024, the Board authorized an incremental increase to our repurchase program and on April 11, 2025, the Board authorized another incremental increase to our repurchase program,&#160;such that,&#160;inclusive of any amounts remaining under the existing repurchase authorization, as of April 11, 2025, we were authorized to repurchase up to&#160;$30.6&#160;million of our Class A common stock.&#160;</span>Under the program, repurchases may be made from time to time in open market transactions, in privately negotiated transactions or otherwise. The timing and actual dollar amount repurchased will depend on a variety of factors, including legal requirements, price, future tax implications and economic and market conditions. The repurchase program may be changed, suspended or discontinued at any time and does not have a specified expiration date.&#160;<!--EndFragment --></span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; text-indent: 45pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; line-height: inherit;"><br/></span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; text-indent: 45pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; line-height: inherit;">During the year ended October 31, 2025, we repurchased <span style="color: #000000; font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 60px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important;"><span id="fs_0QEN9FPPEO00000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">257,908</span></span>&#160;shares of Class A common stock, with a market value of $<span style="border-left: none; border-right: none;"><span id="fs_8FBHAHKA6O00000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">30.1</span></span> million, or $<span style="color: #000000; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 60px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important; line-height: inherit;"><span style="border-left: none; border-right: none;"><span id="fs_JXI2SCZJTS00000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">116.70</span></span></span> per share. During the year ended October 31, 2024, we repurchased <span id="fs_M6E13GQXKG00000000000000000000FM" style="display: inline;">188,800</span> shares of Class A common stock, with a market value of $<span style="color: #000000; font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 60px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important;"><span id="fs_2FUIB1L70000000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">26.5</span></span>&#160;million, or $<span style="color: #000000; font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 60px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important;"><span id="fs_6LN0E0L41C00000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">140.31</span></span>&#160;per share. Share repurchases are added to <span style="color: #000000; font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 60px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important; line-height: inherit;">&#8220;</span>Treasury stock<span style="color: #000000; font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 60px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important; line-height: inherit;">&#8221;</span> on our Consolidated Balance Sheets. As of October 31, 2025, $<span style="border-left: none; border-right: none;"><span id="fs_CATT2PUF1S00000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">26.4</span></span> million of our Class A common stock is available for repurchase under our share repurchase program.</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; text-indent: 45pt; line-height: 1.2;"><br/></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; text-indent: 45pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; line-height: inherit;">On July 12, 2005, we issued <span style="line-height: inherit; display: inline;" id="fs_LFLK9O000000000000000000000000fs">5,600</span> shares of <span style="line-height: inherit; display: inline;" id="fs_01EQ8GRKTS00000000000000000000fs">7.625</span>% Series A preferred stock, with a liquidation preference of $<span style="line-height: inherit; display: inline;" id="fs_GC0KT387R400000000000000000000fs">25,000</span> per share. Dividends on the Series A preferred stock are not cumulative and are payable at an annual rate of <span style="line-height: inherit; display: inline;" id="fs_AS7K2RTCI800000000000000000000fs">7.625</span>%. The Series A preferred stock is not convertible into the Company&#8217;s common stock and is redeemable, in whole or in part, at our option at the liquidation preference of the shares. The Series A preferred stock is traded as depositary shares, with each depositary share representing <span style="line-height: inherit; display: inline;" id="fs_B9QOSGQ6VK00000000000000000000fs">1</span>/<span style="line-height: inherit; display: inline;" id="fs_PTAGQCK73400000000000000000000fs">1000</span>th of a share of Series A preferred stock. The depositary shares are listed on the NASDAQ Global Market under the symbol &#8220;HOVNP.&#8221; During both fiscal <span id="fs_R4H6OJMZIO00000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">2025</span> and <span style="line-height: inherit; display: inline;" id="fs_3B7XQ3KBYO00000000000000000000fs">2024</span> we paid dividends of $<span id="fs_0FBKSWKLFK00000000000000000000FM" style="display: inline;">10.7</span>&#160;million on the Series A preferred stock.</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; line-height: inherit;"><i>Unconsolidated Joint Ventures</i>&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; line-height: inherit;">We have investments in unconsolidated joint ventures in various markets where our homebuilding operations are located. Our investments in unconsolidated joint ventures totaled $163.5 million and $<span style="color: #000000; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 60px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important; line-height: inherit;"><span style="line-height: inherit;" id="fs_B8QXQ7M73K00000000000000000000fs">142.9</span></span> million at <span style="line-height: inherit;" id="fs_25YK5YKELC00000000000000000000FM">October 31, 2025</span> and <span style="line-height: inherit;" id="fs_DH5JZM1AWG00000000000000000000fs">2024</span>, respectively. The increase in our investments of $20.6 million was primarily due to new joint ventures formed during the year, along with income recognized from existing joint ventures,

<p style="margin: 10pt 0pt 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; line-height: inherit;">As of <span style="line-height: inherit;" id="fs_XVS2UD9NBK00000000000000000000FM">October 31, 2025</span> and <span style="line-height: inherit;" id="fs_4TTU0LFT8000000000000000000000fs">2024</span>, our unconsolidated joint ventures had outstanding debt totaling $<span style="border-left: none; border-right: none;"><span id="fs_DBQ6S8JLXC00000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">121.9</span></span>&#160;million and $<span style="color: #000000; font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 60px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important;"><span id="fs_U3MQMWECMO00000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">88.7</span></span>&#160;million, respectively, under separate construction loan agreements with different third-party lenders and affiliates of certain investment partners to finance land development activities. The outstanding debt is secured by the underlying property and related project assets and is nonrecourse to us. Although we and our unconsolidated joint venture partners provide certain guarantees and indemnities to the lender, we do not provide a guaranty or have any other obligation to repay the outstanding debt or to support the value of the collateral underlying the outstanding debt. Our guarantees are limited to performance and completion of development activities, environmental indemnification and standard warranty and representation against fraud, misrepresentation and similar actions, including voluntary bankruptcy. We do not believe that our existing exposure under our guaranty and indemnity obligations related to the outstanding debt of our unconsolidated joint ventures is material.</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; line-height: inherit;">We determined that none of our joint ventures was a variable interest entity. All our unconsolidated joint ventures were accounted for under the equity method because we did not have a controlling financial interest. See Notes <span style="line-height: inherit; display: inline;" id="fs_5O6FQZ2V2800000000000000000000fs">19</span> and <span style="line-height: inherit; display: inline;" id="fs_R40FUS4AV400000000000000000000fs">20</span> to the Consolidated Financial Statements included elsewhere in this Annual Report on Form 10-K for further discussion of joint ventures and variable interest entities.</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; line-height: inherit;"><i>Inventories</i></span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt 7.5pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; line-height: inherit;">Total inventory, excluding consolidated inventory not owned, <span style="line-height: inherit;" id="fs_QM255C4LXC00000000000000000000FM">decreased</span> $<span style="color: #000000; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 60px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important; line-height: inherit;"><span style="line-height: inherit;" id="fs_I51FQPMS1C00000000000000000000fs">129.2</span></span> million during the year ended <span style="line-height: inherit;" id="fs_KAMO6SWSSG00000000000000000000FM">October 31, 2025</span>&#160;from <span style="line-height: inherit;" id="fs_Q795CV750G00000000000000000000FM">October 31, 2024</span>.&#160;Total inventory, excluding consolidated inventory not owned, decreased in the Northeast by $<span style="border-left: none; border-right: none;"><span id="fs_IP1GLLCCCW00000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">83.3</span></span> million, increased in the Southeast by $<span style="border-left: none; border-right: none;"><span id="fs_YM007L234G00000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">108.8</span></span> million and decreased in the West by $<span style="border-left: none; border-right: none;"><span id="fs_0ZEJDNLEO000000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">154.7</span></span> million. The net decrease was primarily attributable to home deliveries, impairments and write-offs, and land sales. However, this reduction was partially offset by new land purchases and land development during fiscal 2025, along with an increase in inventory from the consolidation of previously unconsolidated joint ventures. Substantially all homes under construction or completed and included in inventory at <span style="line-height: inherit;" id="fs_8SIVRDZ1HC00000000000000000000FM">October 31, 2025</span> are expected to close during the next <span style="line-height: inherit; display: inline;" id="fs_ONXTOEQMHC00000000000000000000fs">six</span> to <span style="line-height: inherit; display: inline;" id="fs_F6M9355IPS00000000000000000000fs">nine</span> months.</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; line-height: inherit;">Consolidated inventory not owned, which consists of options related to land banking and model financing, increased $<span style="border-left: none; border-right: none;"><span id="fs_W87ZBCNP1S00000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">121.9</span></span> million during fiscal <span style="line-height: inherit;" id="fs_BN71O85VV400000000000000000000fs">2025</span>.&#160;The increase was primarily&#160;due to an increase in land banking transactions, along with an increase in the sale and leaseback of certain model homes during the period. We have land banking arrangements, whereby we sell land parcels to land bankers and they provide us an option to purchase back finished lots on a predetermined schedule.&#160;Because of our options to repurchase these parcels, these transactions are considered a financing rather than a sale. Our Consolidated Balance Sheet, at October 31, 2025, included inventory of $<span style="border-left: none; border-right: none;"><span id="fs_WK8LXHAFK000000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">258.6</span></span> million recorded to &#8220;Consolidated inventory not owned,&#8221; with a corresponding amount of $<span style="border-left: none; border-right: none;"><span id="fs_FDB32LM6Y800000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">169.1</span></span> million (net of debt issuance costs) recorded to &#8220;Liabilities from inventory not owned&#8221; for the amount of net cash received from the transactions. In addition, we sell and lease back certain of our model homes with the right to participate in the potential profit when each home is sold to a third-party at the end of the respective lease.&#160;As a result of our continued involvement and the ability to repurchase model homes with below market options, these sale and leaseback transactions are considered a financing rather than a sale.&#160;Therefore, our Consolidated Balance Sheet, at <span style="line-height: inherit;" id="fs_ZR9XY3K9MO00000000000000000000FM">October 31, 2025</span>, included inventory of $<span style="border-left: none; border-right: none;"><span id="fs_LCSH8W2ARK00000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">74.3</span></span> million recorded to &#8220;Consolidated inventory not owned,&#8221; with a corresponding amount of $<span style="border-left: none; border-right: none;"><span id="fs_T16WTRCRFK00000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">75.6</span></span> million (net of debt issuance costs) recorded to &#8220;Liabilities from inventory not owned&#8221; for the amount of net cash received from sale and leaseback transactions.</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; line-height: inherit;">In the ordinary course of business, we enter into land and lot option purchase contracts in order to procure land or lots for the construction of homes. Lot option contracts enable us to control significant lot positions with a minimal capital investment and substantially reduce the risks associated with land ownership and development. At <span style="line-height: inherit;" id="fs_XLBZ4ACPJK00000000000000000000FM">October 31, 2025</span>, we had total cash deposits of $<span style="border-left: none; border-right: none;"><span id="fs_OJ262EOAW000000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">333.2</span></span> million to purchase land and lots with a total purchase price of $<span id="fs_DR52PPBD7400000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">2.8</span> billion. Our financial exposure is generally limited to forfeiture of the nonrefundable deposits, letters of credit and other nonrefundable amounts incurred. We have no material third-party guarantees.</span></p>

 </div>
<p style="margin: 10pt 0pt 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; text-indent: 0pt; line-height: 1.2;"><i style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; text-indent: 0pt;">Financial Services Assets and Liabilities&#160;</i></p>
<p style="margin: 10pt 0pt 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; text-indent: 45pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; line-height: inherit;">Financial services assets&#160;consist primarily of residential mortgage receivables held for sale of which $<span id="fs_XVCGZXQD0000000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">109.8</span> million and $<span style="color: #000000; font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 60px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important;"><span id="fs_BWX12IJH2800000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">147.2</span></span> million at <span style="line-height: inherit;" id="fs_5SDBE4UWEO00000000000000000000FM">October 31, 2025</span> and <span style="line-height: inherit;" id="fs_2WGT8QFZKW00000000000000000000fs">2024</span>, respectively, were being temporarily warehoused and are awaiting sale in the secondary mortgage market. The decrease in mortgage loans held for sale from October 31, 2024 was primarily related to a decrease in the volume of loans originated during the fourth quarter of fiscal <span style="border-left: none; border-right: none;"><span id="fs_0BBEUGAUMO00000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">2025</span></span>&#160;compared to the fourth quarter of fiscal <span style="border-left: none; border-right: none;"><span id="fs_1TO03KDDY800000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">2024</span></span>.</span></p>
<p style="margin: 10pt 0pt 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; text-indent: 45pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; line-height: inherit;">Financial services liabilities decreased $<span id="fs_NEYE843SO000000000000000000000fs">52.3</span> million from $<span style="color: #000000; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 37.6px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important; line-height: inherit;"><span id="fs_92LPMFWXN400000000000000000000fs">183.1</span></span> million at <span style="line-height: inherit;" id="fs_OBCIGFYEJK00000000000000000000FM">October 31, 2024</span>, to $<span style="line-height: inherit; border-left: none; border-right: none;"><span id="fs_VDJSD8U0LS00000000000000000000FM">130.9</span></span> million at <span style="line-height: inherit;" id="fs_BFUQMB9C8000000000000000000000FM">October 31, 2025</span>. The decrease was primarily due to the decrease in amounts outstanding under our mortgage warehouse lines of credit and directly correlated&#160;to the decrease in the volume of mortgage loans held for sale.</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; line-height: inherit;"><b>Inflation </b></span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt 15pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; text-indent: 45pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; line-height: inherit;">The annual rate of inflation in the United States was&#160;<span style="border-left: none; border-right: none;"><span id="fs_Y0FGGSFMGG00000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">3.0</span></span>% in September<span style="border-left: none; border-right: none;">&#160;2025</span>, as measured by the most recent publicly available Consumer Price Index, which is slightly higher than October 2024, but much improved from its peak of <span style="line-height: inherit; display: inline;" id="fs_HDESPO6ZXS00000000000000000000fs">9.1</span>% in June 2022. Inflation has a long-term effect, because of higher costs of land, materials and labor results in increasing the sale prices of our homes. Historically, these price increases have been commensurate with the general rate of inflation in our housing markets and have not had a significant adverse effect on the sale of our homes. A significant risk faced by the housing industry generally is that rising house construction costs, including land, labor and interest costs, could substantially outpace increases in the income of potential purchasers and therefore limit our ability to raise home sale prices, which may result in lower gross margins.</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; text-indent: 45pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; text-indent: 45pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; line-height: inherit;">Inflation has a lesser short-term effect, because we generally negotiate fixed-price contracts with many, but not all, of our subcontractors and material suppliers for the construction of our homes. These prices usually are applicable for a specified number of residential buildings or for a time period of between <span style="line-height: inherit; display: inline;" id="fs_2BQQDS0UC000000000000000000000fs">three</span> to <span style="line-height: inherit; display: inline;" id="fs_A1FHEZUQWG00000000000000000000fs">12</span> months. Construction costs for residential buildings represented approximately <span style="border-left: none; border-right: none;"><span id="fs_3XEBGVEUV400000000000000000000fs" style="display: inline;">51</span></span>% of our homebuilding cost of sales for fiscal year <span style="line-height: inherit;" id="fs_CPQFJM35HS00000000000000000000fs">2025</span>.</span></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 15pt; text-indent: 45pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; line-height: inherit;"><b>Critical Accounting Policies</b></span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt 15pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 42.9pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; line-height: inherit;">Management believes that the following critical accounting policies require its most significant judgments and estimates used in the preparation of the Consolidated Financial Statements:</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt 7.5pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; line-height: inherit;"><i>Inventories</i> - Inventories consist of land, land development, home construction costs, capitalized interest, construction overhead and property taxes. Construction costs are accumulated during the period of construction and charged to cost of sales under the specific identification method. Land, land development and common facility costs are allocated based on buildable acres to product types within each community, then charged to cost of sales equally based upon the number of homes to be constructed in each product type.</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt 7.5pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; line-height: inherit;">We record inventories on our Consolidated Balance Sheets at cost unless the inventory is determined to be impaired, in which case the inventory is written down to its fair value. Our inventories consist of the following <span style="line-height: inherit; display: inline;" id="fs_SNNT5NPEZK00000000000000000000fs">three</span> components: (<span style="line-height: inherit; display: inline;" id="fs_GMJBQ0CEWG00000000000000000000fs">1</span>)&#160;sold and unsold homes and lots under development, which includes all construction, land, capitalized interest and land development costs related to started homes and land under development in our active communities; (<span style="line-height: inherit; display: inline;" id="fs_WK85FDF08W00000000000000000000fs">2</span>)&#160;land and land options held for future development or sale, which includes all costs related to land in our communities in planning or mothballed communities; and (<span style="line-height: inherit; display: inline;" id="fs_40IKPRN5S000000000000000000000fs">3</span>)&#160;consolidated inventory not owned, which consists of model homes financed with an investor and inventory related to land banking arrangements accounted for as financings.</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt 7.5pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; line-height: inherit;">We sell and lease back certain of our model homes with the right to participate in the potential profit when each home is sold to a third-party at the end of the respective lease. As a result of our continued involvement and the ability to repurchase model homes with below market options, for accounting purposes in accordance with ASC <span style="line-height: inherit; display: inline;" id="fs_K97GVI67GG00000000000000000000fs">606</span> &#8220;Revenue From Contracts with Customers,&#8221; these sale and leaseback transactions are considered a financing rather than a sale.</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><br/></p>

<tr>
<td class="pgno" style="padding: 0px; text-align: center;"><span class="pageno" style="font-size: 10pt;"><span id="PageBreakNo46" class="pageno">46</span></span></td>

<div class="pageBreak" style="page-break-before: always; font-size: 10pt; text-align: left;"><a href="#TOC">Table of Contents</a></div>




































 </div>
<p style="margin: 10pt 0pt 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; line-height: inherit;">We have land banking arrangements, whereby we sell our land parcels to the land banker and they provide us an option to purchase back finished lots on a predetermined schedule. Because of our options to repurchase these parcels, for accounting purposes in accordance with ASC <span style="line-height: inherit; display: inline;" id="fs_VQM3G8P22O00000000000000000000fs">606</span>, these transactions are considered a&#160;financing&#160;rather than a sale.</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt 7.5pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; line-height: inherit;">The recoverability of inventories and other long-lived assets is assessed in accordance with ASC <span style="line-height: inherit; display: inline;" id="fs_EU3Q3G7UIO00000000000000000000fs">360</span>, &#8220;Property, Plant and Equipment.&#8221; ASC <span style="line-height: inherit; display: inline;" id="fs_OXQ385N6TS00000000000000000000fs">360</span> requires long-lived assets, including inventories, held for development to be evaluated for impairment based on the undiscounted future cash flows of the assets at the lowest level for which there are identifiable cash flows. We evaluate impairment at the individual community level, which is the lowest level of discrete cash flows that are available.</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt 7.5pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; line-height: inherit;">We evaluate inventories of communities under development and held for future development for impairment when indicators of potential impairment are present. Indicators of impairment include, but are not limited to, decreases in local housing market values, decreases in gross margins or sales absorption rates, decreases in net sales prices (base sales price, net of sales incentives), or actual or projected operating or cash flow losses. The assessment of communities for indicators of impairment is performed quarterly. As part of this process, we prepare detailed budgets for all of our communities at least semi-annually and identify those communities with a projected operating loss.&#160;For those communities with projected losses, we estimate the remaining undiscounted future cash flows and compare those to the carrying value of the community, to determine if the carrying value of the asset is recoverable.</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt 7.5pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; line-height: inherit;">The projected operating profits, losses or cash flows of each community can be significantly impacted by our estimates of the following:</span></p>
