<p style="margin: 9pt 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2; margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt;">We rent certain office space for use in our operations. We assess each of these contracts to determine whether the arrangement contains a lease as defined by ASC <em style="font-style: inherit; font-variant: inherit; font-weight: inherit; font-stretch: inherit; line-height: inherit; font-optical-sizing: inherit; font-size-adjust: inherit; font-kerning: inherit; font-feature-settings: inherit; font-variation-settings: inherit;"><span style="display: inline;" id="fs_V9I2AVJW4W00000000000000000000fs">842</span>,</em> &#8220;Leases.&#8221; In order to meet the definition of a lease under ASC <em style="font-style: inherit; font-variant: inherit; font-weight: inherit; font-stretch: inherit; line-height: inherit; font-optical-sizing: inherit; font-size-adjust: inherit; font-kerning: inherit; font-feature-settings: inherit; font-variation-settings: inherit;"><span style="display: inline;" id="fs_G8PQ7RBHSW00000000000000000000fs">842</span>,</em> the contractual arrangement must convey to us the right to control the use of an identifiable asset for a period of time in exchange for consideration. We recognize lease expense on a straight-line basis over the lease term and combine lease and non-lease components for all leases. Our office lease terms are typically from <span style="-sec-ix-hidden:Tag50">three</span> to <ix:nonNumeric name="us-gaap:LesseeOperatingLeaseTermOfContract" contextRef="I20251031_OfficeLeasesMember_MaximumMember" format="ixt-sec:durwordsen" id="Tag118"><span style="border-left: none; border-right: none;"><span style="border-left: none; border-right: none;">five years</span></span></ix:nonNumeric> and generally contain renewal options. In accordance with ASC <em style="font-style: inherit; font-variant: inherit; font-weight: inherit; font-stretch: inherit; line-height: inherit; font-optical-sizing: inherit; font-size-adjust: inherit; font-kerning: inherit; font-feature-settings: inherit; font-variation-settings: inherit;"><span style="display: inline;" id="fs_MP6JKKBDQO00000000000000000000fs">842</span>,</em> our lease terms include renewals only to the extent that they are reasonably certain to be exercised. The exercise of these lease renewal options is generally at our discretion. In accordance with ASC <em style="font-style: inherit; font-variant: inherit; font-weight: inherit; font-stretch: inherit; line-height: inherit; font-optical-sizing: inherit; font-size-adjust: inherit; font-kerning: inherit; font-feature-settings: inherit; font-variation-settings: inherit;"><span style="display: inline;" id="fs_A9VJ8WYDO000000000000000000000fs">842</span>,</em> the lease liability is equal to the present value of the remaining lease payments while the ROU asset is based on the lease liability, subject to adjustment, such as for lease incentives. Our leases do <em style="font-style: inherit; font-variant: inherit; font-weight: inherit; font-stretch: inherit; line-height: inherit; font-optical-sizing: inherit; font-size-adjust: inherit; font-kerning: inherit; font-feature-settings: inherit; font-variation-settings: inherit;">not</em> provide a readily determinable implicit interest rate and therefore, we must estimate our incremental borrowing rate. In determining the incremental borrowing rate, we consider the lease period and our collateralized borrowing rates.</span></p>



































































































<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">Our lease population at <em style="font-style: inherit; font-variant: inherit; font-weight: inherit; font-stretch: inherit; line-height: inherit; font-optical-sizing: inherit; font-size-adjust: inherit; font-kerning: inherit; font-feature-settings: inherit; font-variation-settings: inherit;"> <span id="fs_5WVDJMTCWG00000000000000000000FM">October 31, 2025</span></em> is comprised of operating leases where we are the lessee, primarily for our corporate office and division offices. As allowed by ASC <em style="font-style: inherit; font-variant: inherit; font-weight: inherit; font-stretch: inherit; line-height: inherit; font-optical-sizing: inherit; font-size-adjust: inherit; font-kerning: inherit; font-feature-settings: inherit; font-variation-settings: inherit;"><span style="display: inline;" id="fs_XOIM5IEF3400000000000000000000fs">842</span>,</em> we made an accounting policy election to <em style="font-style: inherit; font-variant: inherit; font-weight: inherit; font-stretch: inherit; line-height: inherit; font-optical-sizing: inherit; font-size-adjust: inherit; font-kerning: inherit; font-feature-settings: inherit; font-variation-settings: inherit;">not</em> record leases with an initial term of <em style="font-style: inherit; font-variant: inherit; font-weight: inherit; font-stretch: inherit; line-height: inherit; font-optical-sizing: inherit; font-size-adjust: inherit; font-kerning: inherit; font-feature-settings: inherit; font-variation-settings: inherit;"><span style="display: inline;" id="fs_6HRY9SYZLC00000000000000000000fs">12</span></em> months or less on our Consolidated Balance Sheets</span></p>
<p style="margin: 9pt 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">Lease costs are included in our Consolidated Statements of Operations, primarily in &#8220;Selling, general and administrative&#8221; homebuilding expenses and payments on our lease liabilities are presented in the table below.</span></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 7.5pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">Our wholly owned mortgage banking subsidiary, K. Hovnanian American Mortgage, LLC (&#8220;K. Hovnanian Mortgage&#8221;), originates mortgage loans, primarily from the sale of our homes. Such mortgage loans and related servicing rights are generally sold in the secondary mortgage market within a short period of time from origination. Mortgage loans held for sale are collateralized by the underlying property. Loans held for sale are recorded at fair value with changes in the value recognized in the Consolidated Statements of Operations in &#8220;Financial services&#8221; revenue.&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt 7.5pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">&#160;&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">At <em style="font-style: inherit; font-variant: inherit; font-weight: inherit; font-stretch: inherit; line-height: inherit; font-optical-sizing: inherit; font-size-adjust: inherit; font-kerning: inherit; font-feature-settings: inherit; font-variation-settings: inherit;"> <span id="fs_1J8AXST6J400000000000000000000FM">October 31, 2025</span>&#160;</em>and <em style="font-style: inherit; font-variant: inherit; font-weight: inherit; font-stretch: inherit; line-height: inherit; font-optical-sizing: inherit; font-size-adjust: inherit; font-kerning: inherit; font-feature-settings: inherit; font-variation-settings: inherit;"><span id="fs_I7JNH2WE0000000000000000000000FM">2024</span></em>, $<ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentCollateralAmount" contextRef="I20251031_CollateralizedDebtObligationsMember" unitRef="USD" decimals="-5" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="Tag167">107.6</ix:nonFraction>&#160;million and $<ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentCollateralAmount" contextRef="I20241031_CollateralizedDebtObligationsMember" unitRef="USD" decimals="-5" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="Tag168">145.7</ix:nonFraction>&#160;million, respectively, of mortgages held for sale were pledged against our mortgage warehouse lines of credit (see Note <em style="font-style: inherit; font-variant: inherit; font-weight: inherit; font-stretch: inherit; line-height: inherit; font-optical-sizing: inherit; font-size-adjust: inherit; font-kerning: inherit; font-feature-settings: inherit; font-variation-settings: inherit;">8</em>). We <em style="font-style: inherit; font-variant: inherit; font-weight: inherit; font-stretch: inherit; line-height: inherit; font-optical-sizing: inherit; font-size-adjust: inherit; font-kerning: inherit; font-feature-settings: inherit; font-variation-settings: inherit;"> may </em>incur losses with respect to mortgages that were previously sold that are delinquent and which had underwriting defects, but only to the extent the losses are <em style="font-style: inherit; font-variant: inherit; font-weight: inherit; font-stretch: inherit; line-height: inherit; font-optical-sizing: inherit; font-size-adjust: inherit; font-kerning: inherit; font-feature-settings: inherit; font-variation-settings: inherit;">not</em> covered by mortgage insurance or the resale value of the home. The reserves for these estimated losses are included in &#8220;Financial services&#8221; liabilities on the Consolidated Balance Sheets. At<em style="font-style: inherit; font-variant: inherit; font-weight: inherit; font-stretch: inherit; line-height: inherit; font-optical-sizing: inherit; font-size-adjust: inherit; font-kerning: inherit; font-feature-settings: inherit; font-variation-settings: inherit;">&#160;<span id="fs_AILXVJ8X9S00000000000000000000FM">October 31, 2025</span>&#160;</em>and <em style="font-style: inherit; font-variant: inherit; font-weight: inherit; font-stretch: inherit; line-height: inherit; font-optical-sizing: inherit; font-size-adjust: inherit; font-kerning: inherit; font-feature-settings: inherit; font-variation-settings: inherit;"><span id="fs_VHEP8CLVY800000000000000000000FM">2024</span></em>, we had specific reserves for <ix:nonFraction name="hov:NumberOfLoansReservedFor" contextRef="I20251031_CollateralizedDebtObligationsMember" unitRef="NUMBER" decimals="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="Tag177">9</ix:nonFraction> and <ix:nonFraction name="hov:NumberOfLoansReservedFor" contextRef="I20241031_CollateralizedDebtObligationsMember" unitRef="NUMBER" decimals="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="Tag176">10</ix:nonFraction>&#160;identified mortgage loans, respectively, as well as reserves for an estimate of future losses on mortgages sold but <em style="font-style: inherit; font-variant: inherit; font-weight: inherit; font-stretch: inherit; line-height: inherit; font-optical-sizing: inherit; font-size-adjust: inherit; font-kerning: inherit; font-feature-settings: inherit; font-variation-settings: inherit;">not</em> yet identified to us.&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 45pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">Except for K. Hovnanian, the issuer of the notes and borrower under the credit agreement governing our secured revolving credit facility (the <span style="color: #000000; font-size: 13.3333px; font-variant-ligatures: normal; <p style="text-indent: 45pt; line-height: 1.2; margin: 0in;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit; font-family: 'times new roman', times;"><span style="line-height: inherit;">The credit agreement governing the Secured Credit Facility and the indentures governing the senior notes (together, the <span style="color: #000000; line-height: inherit;">&#8220;</span>Debt Instruments<span style="color: #000000; line-height: inherit;">&#8221;</span>) outstanding at <span id="fs_32ORSU5V8W00000000000000000000FM" style="line-height: inherit;">October 31, 2025</span> do not contain any financial maintenance covenants, but do contain restrictive covenants that limit, among other things, the ability of HEI and certain of its subsidiaries, including K. Hovnanian, to incur (including through exchanges or certain other types of transactions) indebtedness, pay dividends, including on our preferred stock, and make distributions on common and preferred stock, repay/repurchase certain indebtedness prior to its respective stated maturity, repurchase common and preferred stock, make other restricted payments (including investments), sell certain assets (including in certain land banking transactions), incur liens, consolidate, merge, sell or otherwise dispose of all or substantially all of their assets and enter into certain transactions with affiliates. The Debt Instruments also contain customary events of default which would permit the lenders or holders thereof to exercise remedies with respect to the collateral (as applicable), declare the loans under the Secured Credit Facility (the <span style="color: #000000; line-height: inherit;">&#8220;</span>Secured Revolving Loans<span style="color: #000000; line-height: inherit;">&#8221;</span>) made under the Credit Agreement, dated as of <span id="fs_8PVDLQTUKG00000000000000000000FM" style="line-height: inherit;">October 31, 2019,</span> as amended, by and among K. Hovnanian, the Company, the other guarantors party thereto, Wilmington Trust, National Association, as administrative agent, and the lenders party thereto (the <span style="color: #000000; line-height: inherit;">&#8220;</span>Secured Credit Agreement<span style="color: #000000; line-height: inherit;">&#8221;</span>) or notes to be immediately due and payable if not cured within applicable grace periods, including the failure to make timely payments on the Secured Revolving Loans or notes or other material indebtedness, cross default to other material indebtedness, the failure to comply with agreements and covenants and specified events of bankruptcy and insolvency and, with respect to the Secured Revolving Loans, material inaccuracy of representations and warranties, a change of control, the failure of the documents granting security for the obligations under the Secured Credit Agreement to be in full force and effect, and the failure of the liens on any material portion of the collateral securing the obligations under the Secured Credit Agreement to be valid and perfected. As of <span id="fs_6K1I1NEKO000000000000000000000FM" style="line-height: inherit;">October 31, 2025</span>, we believe we were in compliance with the covenants of the Debt Instruments.</span></span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt 7.5pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><br/></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 45pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">Under the terms of our Debt Instruments, we have the right to make certain redemptions and prepayments and, depending on market conditions, our strategic priorities and covenant restrictions,&#160;<em style="font-style: inherit; font-variant: inherit; font-weight: inherit; font-stretch: inherit; line-height: inherit; font-optical-sizing: inherit; font-size-adjust: inherit; font-kerning: inherit; font-feature-settings: inherit; font-variation-settings: inherit;">may </em>do so from time to time. We will also continue to analyze and evaluate our capital structure and explore transactions to strengthen our balance sheet, including those that reduce leverage, interest rates and/or extend maturities, and will seek to do so with the right opportunity. We <em style="font-style: inherit; font-variant: inherit; font-weight: inherit; font-stretch: inherit; line-height: inherit; font-optical-sizing: inherit; font-size-adjust: inherit; font-kerning: inherit; font-feature-settings: inherit; font-variation-settings: inherit;"> may </em>also continue to make debt or equity purchases and/or exchanges from time to time through tender offers, exchange offers, redemptions, open market purchases, private transactions, or otherwise, or seek to raise additional debt or equity capital, depending on market conditions and covenant restrictions.</span></p>

income before taxes and non-deductible executive compensation, along with less state net operating losses (<span style="color: #000000; font-size: 13.3333px; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: start; text-indent: 60px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important; line-height: inherit;">&#8220;</span>NOL<span style="color: #000000; font-size: 13.3333px; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: start; text-indent: 48px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important; line-height: inherit;">&#8221;) available to utilize. These increases were partially&#160;</span>offset&#160;by energy efficient home
tax credits. In fiscal 2025, income tax expense was further reduced by the
benefit of deductible losses from our debt extinguishment. </span><span style="font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">Income
tax expense for fiscal years 2024 and 2023 includes the favorable impact of
releasing state valuation allowances. The federal tax expense for all periods
presented was not paid in cash as it was offset by the use of our existing
NOL&#160;carryforwards.</span></span></p>

<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 45pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">

<p style="text-indent: 45pt; line-height: 1.2; margin: 0in; font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'times new roman', times; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 45pt; line-height: inherit;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 45pt; line-height: inherit;">On July <span style="font-size: 10pt; color: black; font-variant: normal; line-height: inherit;">4, 2025, the One Big Beautiful Bill Act ("OBBBA") was enacted and signed into U.S. law. The OBBBA modifies or extends provisions enacted by the 2017 Tax Cuts and Jobs Act and introduces new provisions including the repeal of our ability to claim energy efficient home credits for homes that close after June 30, 2026. While the OBBBA does not have a material impact </span>on our Consolidated Financial Statements, we will continue to monitor additional guidance issued by the U.S. Treasury Department, the Internal Revenue Service and various state agencies.</span></span></p>

As part of our analysis, we considered both positive and negative factors that impact profitability and whether those factors would lead to a change in estimate of our deferred tax assets (&#8220;DTAs&#8221;) that may be realized in the future. At October 31, 2025, the Company has determined that it is more likely than not that sufficient taxable income will be generated in the future to realize its DTAs, net of any state valuation allowances.</span></span></p>

<p style="text-indent: 45pt; margin: 0pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'times new roman', times; line-height: inherit;">The consolidated federal tax returns have been audited through<i> </i>October 31, 2024 and these years are closed. We are also subject to various income tax examinations in the states in which we do business. The outcome for a particular audit cannot be determined with certainty prior to the conclusion of the audit, appeal, and in some cases, litigation process. As each audit is concluded, adjustments, if any, are recorded in the period determined. To provide for potential exposures, tax reserves are recorded, if applicable, based on reasonable estimates of potential audit results. However, if the reserves are insufficient upon completion of an audit, there could be an adverse impact on our financial position and results of operations. The statute of limitations for our major tax jurisdictions remains open for examination for tax years<i> </i><span style="-sec-ix-hidden:Tag56">2021 to 2024</span>.</span></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;"><b><em style="font-style: inherit; font-variant: inherit; font-weight: inherit; font-stretch: inherit; line-height: inherit; font-optical-sizing: inherit; font-size-adjust: inherit; font-kerning: inherit; font-feature-settings: inherit; font-variation-settings: inherit;">14.</em> Capital Stock</b></span></p>
<p style="margin: -2px; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;"><i>Common Stock</i></span></p>
<p style="margin: -2pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">Each share of Class&#160;A common stock entitles its holder to <span style="border-left: none; border-right: none; line-height: inherit;"><ix:nonFraction name="hov:CommonStockVotingRightsVotesPerShareNumber" contextRef="D20251031_CommonClassAMember" unitRef="Item" decimals="0" format="ixt-sec:numwordsen" id="Tag813">one</ix:nonFraction></span> vote per share, and each share of Class&#160;B common stock generally entitles its holder to <span style="border-left: none; border-right: none; line-height: inherit;"><ix:nonFraction name="hov:CommonStockVotingRightsVotesPerShareNumber" contextRef="D20251031_CommonClassBMember" unitRef="Item" decimals="0" format="ixt-sec:numwordsen" id="Tag816">ten</ix:nonFraction></span> votes per share. The amount of any regular cash dividend payable on a share of Class&#160;A common stock will be an amount equal to <ix:nonFraction name="hov:CommonStockDividendsPercentOfIncreaseFromClassAToClassB" contextRef="I20251031" unitRef="Pure" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="Tag815">110</ix:nonFraction>% of the corresponding regular cash dividend payable on a share of Class&#160;B common stock. If a shareholder desires to sell shares of Class&#160;B common stock, such stock must be converted into shares of Class&#160;A common stock at a <span style="border-left: none; border-right: none; line-height: inherit;"><ix:nonFraction name="hov:ConversionOfStockFromClassBToClassAConversionRatio" contextRef="D20251031" unitRef="Pure" decimals="0" format="ixt-sec:numwordsen" id="Tag814">one</ix:nonFraction></span>-to-<em style="font-style: inherit; font-variant: inherit; font-weight: inherit; font-stretch: inherit; line-height: inherit; font-optical-sizing: inherit; font-size-adjust: inherit; font-kerning: inherit; font-feature-settings: inherit; font-variation-settings: inherit;">one</em> conversion rate.</span></p>
<p style="margin: -2pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="text-indent: 45pt; line-height: 1.2; margin: 0in; font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit; font-family: 'times new roman', times;">On August&#160;<span style="line-height: inherit;">4</span>, <span style="line-height: inherit;">2008</span>,&#160;the Board of Directors of the Company (the <span style="color: #000000; font-size: 13.3333px; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: start; text-indent: 60px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; line-height: inherit; display: inline !important;">&#8220;</span>Board<em style="color: #000000; font-size: 13.3333px; font-variant: inherit; font-weight: inherit; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 60px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: #ffffff; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; font-style: inherit; font-stretch: inherit; line-height: inherit; font-optical-sizing: inherit; font-size-adjust: inherit; font-kerning: inherit; font-feature-settings: inherit; font-variation-settings: inherit;">&#8221;</em>) adopted a shareholder rights plan
(the &#8220;Rights Plan&#8221;), which was amended on January 11, 2018,&#160;January 18,
2021 and January 11, 2024,&#160;designed to preserve shareholder value and the
value of certain tax assets primarily associated with NOL&#160;carryforwards and built-in losses under Section&#160;<span style="line-height: inherit;">382</span> of the Internal Revenue Code. Our ability to use
NOLs and built-in losses would be limited if there was an &#8220;ownership change&#8221;
under Section&#160;<span style="line-height: inherit;">382</span>. This would occur if
shareholders owning (or deemed under Section&#160;<span style="line-height: inherit;">382</span>
to own) <span style="line-height: inherit;"><ix:nonFraction name="hov:ShareholderOwnershipPercentage" contextRef="I20180111_MinimumMember" unitRef="Pure" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="Tag818">5</ix:nonFraction></span>% or more of our stock increase their
collective ownership of the aggregate amount of our outstanding shares by more
than <span style="line-height: inherit;"><ix:nonFraction name="hov:ShareholderOwnershipPercentageOfIncrease" contextRef="I20180111" unitRef="Pure" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="Tag841">50</ix:nonFraction></span>&#160;percentage points over a defined
period of time. The Rights Plan was adopted to reduce the likelihood of an
&#8220;ownership change&#8221; occurring as defined by Section&#160;<span style="line-height: inherit;">382</span>.
Under the Rights Plan, <span style="line-height: inherit;"><ix:nonFraction name="hov:NumberOfRights" contextRef="I20180111_CommonClassAMember" unitRef="Pure" decimals="0" format="ixt-sec:numwordsen" id="Tag817">one</ix:nonFraction></span> right was distributed
for each share of Class&#160;A common stock and Class&#160;B common stock
outstanding as of the close of business on August&#160;<span style="line-height: inherit;">15</span>,
<span style="line-height: inherit;">2008</span>. Effective August&#160;<span style="line-height: inherit;">15</span>, <span style="line-height: inherit;">2008</span>, if any person
or group acquires <span style="line-height: inherit;"><ix:nonFraction name="hov:ShareholderOwnershipPercentage" contextRef="I20180815_CommonClassAMember" unitRef="Pure" decimals="3" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="Tag825">4.9</ix:nonFraction></span>% or more of the outstanding
shares of Class&#160;A common stock without the approval of the Board, there
would be a triggering event causing significant dilution in the voting power of
such person or group. However, existing shareholders who owned, at the time of
the Rights Plan&#8217;s initial adoption on August 4, 2008, <span style="line-height: inherit;"><ix:nonFraction name="hov:ShareholderOwnershipPercentage" contextRef="I20180815_CommonClassAMember" unitRef="Pure" decimals="3" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="Tag824">4.9</ix:nonFraction></span>%
or more of the outstanding shares of Class&#160;A common stock will trigger a
dilutive event only if they acquire additional shares. The approval of the
Board&#8217;s decision to adopt the Rights Plan may be terminated by the Board at any
time prior to the Rights being triggered. The Rights Plan will continue in
effect until August&#160;<span style="line-height: inherit;">14</span>, <span style="line-height: inherit;">2027</span>, unless it expires earlier in accordance with its
terms. The approval of the Board&#8217;s decision to initially adopt the Rights Plan
and Amendment&#160;Nos. <span style="line-height: inherit;">1</span>, <span style="line-height: inherit;">2</span>
and <span style="line-height: inherit;">3</span> thereto were&#160;approved by shareholders.
Our shareholders also approved an amendment to our Certificate of Incorporation
to restrict certain transfers of Class A common stock in order to preserve the
tax treatment of our NOLs and built-in losses under Section&#160;<span style="line-height: inherit;">382</span> of the Internal Revenue Code. Subject to certain
exceptions pertaining to pre-existing<span style="border-left: none; border-right: none; line-height: inherit;"> <span style="line-height: inherit;"><ix:nonFraction name="hov:ShareholdersPreExistingOwnershipPercentage" contextRef="I20180111_CommonClassAMember" unitRef="Pure" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="Tag823">5</ix:nonFraction></span></span>%

(i) increase the direct or indirect ownership of our stock by any person (or

percentage of our common stock owned directly or indirectly by a person (or
public group) owning or deemed to own <span style="line-height: inherit;"><ix:nonFraction name="hov:ShareholdersOwnershipPercentageOnTransfers" contextRef="I20180111_CommonClassAMember" unitRef="Pure" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="Tag819">5</ix:nonFraction></span>% or more

<p style="margin: 9pt 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.1;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;"><i>Preferred Stock</i></span><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; text-indent: 45pt; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; line-height: inherit;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit; margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt;">On <em style="font-style: inherit; font-variant: inherit; font-weight: inherit; font-stretch: inherit; line-height: inherit; font-optical-sizing: inherit; font-size-adjust: inherit; font-kerning: inherit; font-feature-settings: inherit; font-variation-settings: inherit;"> July&#160;</em><em style="font-style: inherit; font-variant: inherit; font-weight: inherit; font-stretch: inherit; line-height: inherit; font-optical-sizing: inherit; font-size-adjust: inherit; font-kerning: inherit; font-feature-settings: inherit; font-variation-settings: inherit;">12,</em> <em style="font-style: inherit; font-variant: inherit; font-weight: inherit; font-stretch: inherit; line-height: inherit; font-optical-sizing: inherit; font-size-adjust: inherit; font-kerning: inherit; font-feature-settings: inherit; font-variation-settings: inherit;">2005,</em> we issued <ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:PreferredStockSharesIssued" contextRef="I20050712_PreferredClassAMember" unitRef="Shares" decimals="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="Tag829">5,600</ix:nonFraction> shares of <ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:PreferredStockDividendRatePercentage" contextRef="D20050712_PreferredClassAMember" unitRef="Pure" decimals="5" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="Tag828">7.625</ix:nonFraction>% Series&#160;A preferred stock, with a liquidation preference of $<ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:PreferredStockLiquidationPreference" contextRef="I20050712_PreferredClassAMember" unitRef="USDPerShare" decimals="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="Tag827">25,000</ix:nonFraction> per share. Dividends on the Series&#160;A preferred stock are <em style="font-style: inherit; font-variant: inherit; font-weight: inherit; font-stretch: inherit; line-height: inherit; font-optical-sizing: inherit; font-size-adjust: inherit; font-kerning: inherit; font-feature-settings: inherit; font-variation-settings: inherit;">not</em> cumulative and are payable at an annual rate of <ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:PreferredStockDividendRatePercentage" contextRef="D20050712_PreferredClassAMember" unitRef="Pure" decimals="5" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="Tag830">7.625</ix:nonFraction>%. <p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 45pt; text-align: left; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;"><i>RSUs and Performance Units</i></span></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 45pt; text-align: left; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">RSUs are measured based upon the fair value of a share of our Class A common stock on the date of grant. Shares underlying RSUs granted to officers and associates generally vest in <ix:nonFraction name="hov:SharebasedCompensationArrangementBySharebasedPaymentAwardNumberOfInstallments" contextRef="I20251031_RestrictedStockUnitsRSUMember_OfficersAndAssociatesMember" unitRef="Pure" decimals="0" format="ixt-sec:numwordsen" id="Tag278">four</ix:nonFraction> equal installments on the <span style="-sec-ix-hidden:Tag36">first</span>, <span style="-sec-ix-hidden:Tag35">second</span>, <span style="-sec-ix-hidden:Tag34">third</span>, and <span style="-sec-ix-hidden:Tag33">fourth</span> anniversaries of the grant date. During fiscal year <em style="font-style: inherit; font-variant: inherit; font-weight: inherit; font-stretch: inherit; line-height: inherit; font-optical-sizing: inherit; font-size-adjust: inherit; font-kerning: inherit; font-feature-settings: inherit; font-variation-settings: inherit;"><span id="fs_7D0C2Y0TMO00000000000000000000fs" style="line-height: inherit;">2025</span>,</em> each of our <ix:nonFraction name="hov:NumberOfDirectors" contextRef="I20251031_NonemployeeDirectorMember" unitRef="Item" decimals="0" format="ixt-sec:numwordsen" id="Tag277">six</ix:nonFraction> existing non-employee directors were granted RSUs subject to a <span style="border-left: none; border-right: none; line-height: inherit;"><span style="-sec-ix-hidden:Tag46">two</span></span>-year post-vesting holding period. Generally, participants aged <span style="border-left: none; border-right: none;"><ix:nonNumeric name="hov:SharebasedCompensationArrangementBySharebasedPaymentAwardPostvestingHoldingPeriod" contextRef="D20251031_RestrictedStockMember_ParticipantsWithoutServiceRequirementMember" format="ixt-sec:duryear" id="Tag349">60</ix:nonNumeric> years</span> or older, or aged <span style="border-left: none; border-right: none;"><ix:nonNumeric name="hov:SharebasedCompensationArrangementBySharebasedPaymentAwardParticipantsAge" contextRef="D20251031_RestrictedStockMember_ParticipantsWithServiceRequirementMember" format="ixt-sec:duryear" id="Tag350">58</ix:nonNumeric></span> with <ix:nonNumeric name="hov:SharebasedCompensationArrangementBySharebasedPaymentAwardParticipantsYearsOfService" contextRef="D20251031" format="ixt-sec:durwordsen" id="Tag270">15 years</ix:nonNumeric> of service, are eligible to vest in their awards on an accelerated basis upon their retirement.</span></p>

Share adjustments are reflected in the &#8220;Granted&#8221; line above at the time the performance is finalized. Each of the <span id="fs_TE5P9484E800000000000000000000FM" style="line-height: inherit;">2025</span>, <span id="fs_QD2VTORN4W00000000000000000000FM" style="line-height: inherit;">2024</span> and <span id="fs_JBHCE2C08000000000000000000000FM" style="line-height: inherit;">2023</span> LTIP awards are subject to cliff vesting at the end of the performance period.</span></p>

<div id="fs_FVEIMI0N2800000000000000000000B" style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt;"><ix:nonNumeric name="us-gaap:ProductWarrantyDisclosureTextBlock" contextRef="D20251031" escape="true" id="Tag363">
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2; text-indent: 0pt;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;"><b><em style="font-style: inherit; font-variant: inherit; font-weight: inherit; font-stretch: inherit; line-height: inherit; font-optical-sizing: inherit; font-size-adjust: inherit; font-kerning: inherit; font-feature-settings: inherit; font-variation-settings: inherit;">16.</em> Warranty Costs </b></span></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; line-height: 1.2; text-indent: 45pt;"><br/></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">General liability insurance for homebuilding companies and their suppliers and subcontractors is exceedingly difficult to obtain. The availability of general liability insurance is limited due to a decreased number of insurance companies willing to underwrite for the industry. In addition, those few insurers willing to underwrite liability insurance have significantly increased the premium costs. To date, we have been able to obtain general liability insurance but at higher premium costs with higher deductibles. Our subcontractors and suppliers have advised us that they have also had difficulty obtaining insurance that also provides us coverage. As a result, we have an owner-controlled insurance program for certain of our subcontractors whereby the subcontractors pay us an insurance premium (through a reduction of amounts we would otherwise owe such subcontractors for their work on our homes) based on the risk type of the trade. We absorb the liability associated with their work on our homes as part of our overall general liability insurance at <em style="font-style: inherit; font-variant: inherit; font-weight: inherit; font-stretch: inherit; line-height: inherit; font-optical-sizing: inherit; font-size-adjust: inherit; font-kerning: inherit; font-feature-settings: inherit; font-variation-settings: inherit;">no</em> additional cost to us because our existing general liability and construction defect insurance policy and related reserves for amounts under our deductible covers construction defects regardless of whether we or our subcontractors are responsible for the defect. For the years ended <em style="font-style: inherit; font-variant: inherit; font-weight: inherit; font-stretch: inherit; line-height: inherit; font-optical-sizing: inherit; font-size-adjust: inherit; font-kerning: inherit; font-feature-settings: inherit; font-variation-settings: inherit;"> <span id="fs_VBDPK1AP1S00000000000000000000FM" style="line-height: inherit;">October 31, 2025</span> </em>and <em style="font-style: inherit; font-variant: inherit; font-weight: inherit; font-stretch: inherit; line-height: inherit; font-optical-sizing: inherit; font-size-adjust: inherit; font-kerning: inherit; font-feature-settings: inherit; font-variation-settings: inherit;"><span id="fs_J0WCSX8M9C00000000000000000000FM" style="line-height: inherit;">2024</span></em>, we received $<ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:ProceedsFromInsurancePremiumsCollected" contextRef="D20251031_OwnercontrolledInsuranceProgramForSubcontractorsMember" unitRef="USD" decimals="-5" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="Tag362">5.2</ix:nonFraction> million and $<ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:ProceedsFromInsurancePremiumsCollected" contextRef="D20241031_OwnercontrolledInsuranceProgramForSubcontractorsMember" unitRef="USD" decimals="-5" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="Tag360">4.7</ix:nonFraction> million, respectively, from subcontractors related to the owner controlled-insurance program, which we accounted for as reductions to inventory.</span>








</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'times new roman', times; line-height: inherit;">We are involved in litigation, claims and other proceedings arising in the ordinary
course of business. The significant majority of our litigation
matters are related to construction defect claims. Our estimated losses from
construction defect litigation matters, if any, are included in our
construction defect reserves.&#160;</span><span style="font-size: 10.0pt;">While the outcome of such contingencies cannot be
predicted with certainty, we do not believe that the resolution of such matters
will have a material adverse impact on our results of financial position, results
of operations or cash flows.</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-indent: 45pt; line-height: 1.2; font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif;"><br/></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-indent: 45pt; line-height: 1.2; font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; line-height: inherit;">In December 2020, the New Jersey
Department of Environmental Protection (<span style="color: #000000; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: start; text-indent: 60px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important; line-height: inherit;">&#8220;</span>NJDEP<span style="color: #000000; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: start; text-indent: 60px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important; line-height: inherit;">&#8221;</span>) and the
Administrator of the New Jersey Spill Compensation Fund (the &#8220;Spill Fund&#8221;)
filed a lawsuit in the Superior Court of New Jersey, Law Division, Union County
against Hovnanian Enterprises, Inc., in addition to other unrelated parties, in
connection with contamination at Hickory Manor, a residential condominium
development. Alleged predecessors of certain defendants had used the Hickory
Manor property for decades for manufacturing purposes.&#160;In&#160;1998















<span style="font-size: 10.0pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman',serif; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-ansi-language: EN-US; mso-fareast-language: EN-US; mso-bidi-language: AR-SA;">(when one of our affiliates purchased the
property and assumed control of its remediation)</span>, NJDEP confirmed that groundwater at this site was
impacted from an off-site source. The site was later remediated, resulting in
the NJDEP issuing an unconditional site-wide No Further Action determination
letter (<span style="color: #000000; font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: start; text-indent: 60px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important;">&#8220;</span>NFA<span style="color: #000000; font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: start; text-indent: 60px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important;">&#8221;</span>) and Covenant Not to Sue in&#160;1999.
Subsequently,&#160;one&#160;of our affiliates was
involved in redeveloping the property as a residential community. The complaint
asserts claims under the New Jersey Spill Act and other state law claims and
alleges that















<span style="font-size: 10.0pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman',serif; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-ansi-language: EN-US; mso-fareast-language: EN-US; mso-bidi-language: AR-SA;">remediation was not properly completed,
inaccurate reports were provided to NJDEP when the NFA was issued, and </span>


the NJDEP and the Spill Fund have incurred over $<ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:LossContingencyDamagesSoughtValue" contextRef="D20251031_SpillFundLawsuitMember" unitRef="USD" decimals="-5" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="Tag110">5.3</ix:nonFraction>&#160;million since&#160;2009&#160;to
investigate vapor intrusion at the development and to install vapor mitigation
systems. Among other things, the complaint seeks recovery of the costs
incurred, an order that defendants perform additional required remediation and
disgorgement of profits on our affiliate&#8217;s sales of the units in the
development. Discovery has commenced.&#160;Hovnanian Enterprises, Inc. intends
to defend these claims vigorously.</span></span></p>

<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>

<div id="fs_N7L3GUNDJ400000000000000000000B"><ix:nonNumeric name="us-gaap:VariableInterestEntityDisclosureTextBlock" contextRef="D20251031" escape="true" id="Tag1077">
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2; text-indent: 0pt;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;"><b><em style="font-style: inherit; font-variant: inherit; font-weight: inherit; font-stretch: inherit; line-height: inherit; font-optical-sizing: inherit; font-size-adjust: inherit; font-kerning: inherit; font-feature-settings: inherit; font-variation-settings: inherit;">19.</em> Variable Interest Entities</b></span></p>
<p style="margin: 0px; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2; text-indent: 0px;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="text-indent: 45pt; margin: 0in; line-height: 1.2; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="line-height: inherit; font-family: 'times new roman', times;">ASC&#160;810 requires the assessment of whether an
entity is a VIE and, if so, if we are the primary beneficiary at the inception
of the entity or at a reconsideration event. We are required to consolidate a VIE if we determine that we have a controlling financial interest in the VIE.&#160;Controlling
financial interests will have both of the following characteristics: (a) the
power to direct the activities of a VIE that most significantly impact the VIE&#8217;s
economic performance and (b) the obligation to absorb losses of the VIE that
could potentially be significant to the VIE or the right to receive benefits
from the VIE that could potentially be significant to the VIE. Our variable
interest in VIEs are in the form of joint ventures and land and lot option
purchase contracts. </span></p>
<p style="text-indent: 45pt; line-height: 1.2; margin: 0in; font-size: 12pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit; font-family: 'times new roman', times;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="text-indent: 45pt; margin: 0in; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit; font-family: 'times new roman', times;">We examine specific criteria and use our judgment when
determining if we are the primary beneficiary of a VIE and have a controlling financial interest. The&#160;significant
factors we consider in determining whether we are the primary beneficiary include
risk and reward sharing, experience and financial condition of other
partner(s), voting rights, involvement in day-to-day capital and operating
decisions, representation on a VIE&#8217;s executive committee, existence of
unilateral kick-out rights or voting rights, level of economic
disproportionality between us and the other partner(s) and contracts to
purchase property from VIEs.</span></p>
<p style="text-indent: 45pt; margin: 0in; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit; font-family: 'times new roman', times;"><br/></span></p>
<p style="text-indent: 45pt; margin: 0in; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit; font-family: 'times new roman', times;"></span><span style="font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit; font-family: 'times new roman', times;"><span style="color: #000000; font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: start; text-indent: 60px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; line-height: inherit; display: inline !important;">We also enter into land and lot option purchase contracts to procure land or lots for the construction of homes. Under these contracts, the Company will fund a stated deposit in consideration for the right, but not the obligation, to purchase land or lots at a future point in time with predetermined terms. Under the terms of the option purchase contracts, many of the option deposits are not refundable at the Company</span><span style="color: #000000; font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: start; text-indent: 60px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; line-height: inherit;">&#8217;</span><span style="color: #000000; font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: start; text-indent: 60px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; line-height: inherit; display: inline !important;">s discretion.&#160;Under the requirements of ASC&#160;810, certain option purchase contracts may result in the creation of a VIE that owns the land parcel under option.&#160;</span></span></p>
<p style="text-indent: 45pt; margin: 0in; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit; font-family: 'times new roman', times;"><span style="color: #000000; font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: start; text-indent: 60px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important;"><br/></span></span></p>
<p style="text-indent: 45pt; margin: 0in; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit; font-family: 'times new roman', times;"><span style="color: #000000; font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: start; text-indent: 60px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important;">As a result of our analyses, we have concluded we are not the primary beneficiary and do not have a controlling financial interest of any of the land or lots under option purchase contracts at either October&#160;31, 2025&#160;or 2024.</span></span></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">We enter into homebuilding and land development joint ventures from time to time as a means of accessing lot positions, expanding our market opportunities, establishing strategic alliances, managing our risk profile, leveraging our capital base and enhancing returns on capital.&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><br/></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">During the <span style="color: #000000; font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: start; text-indent: 60px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important; line-height: inherit;">second</span> quarter of fiscal <em style="font-style: inherit; font-variant: inherit; font-weight: inherit; font-stretch: inherit; line-height: inherit; font-optical-sizing: inherit; font-size-adjust: inherit; font-kerning: inherit; font-feature-settings: inherit; font-variation-settings: inherit;"><span id="fs_4VEKIUSB1C00000000000000000000fs" style="line-height: inherit;">2024</span>,</em> we contributed <ix:nonFraction name="hov:NumberOfOwnedCommunitiesTransferredToTheJointVenture" contextRef="D20240430" unitRef="Item" decimals="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="Tag1516">11</ix:nonFraction> communities we owned, including <ix:nonFraction name="hov:NumberOfOwnedActiveCommunitiesTransferredToTheJointVenture" contextRef="D20240430" unitRef="Item" decimals="0" format="ixt-sec:numwordsen" id="Tag1515">three</ix:nonFraction> active selling communities, to a new unconsolidated joint venture for $<ix:nonFraction name="hov:ProceedsFromTransferOfLandToJointVenture" contextRef="D20240430" unitRef="USD" decimals="-5" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" id="Tag1514">53.8</ix:nonFraction> million of net cash.</span></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">Typically, our unconsolidated joint ventures obtain separate project specific mortgage financing. For some of our unconsolidated joint ventures, obtaining financing was challenging, therefore, some of our unconsolidated joint ventures are capitalized only with equity. Any unconsolidated joint venture financing is on a nonrecourse basis, with guarantees from us limited only to performance and completion of development, environmental warranties and indemnification, standard indemnification for fraud, misrepresentation and other similar actions, including a voluntary bankruptcy filing. In some instances, the unconsolidated joint venture entity is considered a VIE due to the returns being capped to the equity holders; however, in these instances, we have determined that we are <em style="font-style: inherit; font-variant: inherit; font-weight: inherit; font-stretch: inherit; line-height: inherit; font-optical-sizing: inherit; font-size-adjust: inherit; font-kerning: inherit; font-feature-settings: inherit; font-variation-settings: inherit;">not</em> the primary beneficiary, and therefore we do <em style="font-style: inherit; font-variant: inherit; font-weight: inherit; font-stretch: inherit; line-height: inherit; font-optical-sizing: inherit; font-size-adjust: inherit; font-kerning: inherit; font-feature-settings: inherit; font-variation-settings: inherit;">not</em> consolidate these entities.</span></p>







































</ix:nonNumeric></div>










































 </div>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; line-height: 1.2; text-indent: 0pt;"><br/></p><div style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt;">
<div style="border-left: none; border-right: none;">
<div id="fs_V969MLCTKW00000000000000000000B"><ix:nonNumeric name="us-gaap:FairValueDisclosuresTextBlock" contextRef="D20251031" escape="true" id="Tag567">
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2; text-indent: 0pt;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;"><b><em style="font-style: inherit; font-variant: inherit; font-weight: inherit; font-stretch: inherit; line-height: inherit; font-optical-sizing: inherit; font-size-adjust: inherit; font-kerning: inherit; font-feature-settings: inherit; font-variation-settings: inherit;"><span style="display: inline; line-height: inherit;">21</span>.</em> Fair Value of Financial Instruments</b></span></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">We use a fair-value hierarchy which prioritizes the inputs used in measuring fair value as follows:</span></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">Level <em style="font-style: inherit; font-variant: inherit; font-weight: inherit; font-stretch: inherit; line-height: inherit; font-optical-sizing: inherit; font-size-adjust: inherit; font-kerning: inherit; font-feature-settings: inherit; font-variation-settings: inherit;"><span style="line-height: inherit; display: inline;" id="fs_2T3LUHR9I800000000000000000000fs">1</span>:</em> Fair value determined based on quoted prices in active markets for identical assets.</span></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">Level <em style="font-style: inherit; font-variant: inherit; font-weight: inherit; font-stretch: inherit; line-height: inherit; font-optical-sizing: inherit; font-size-adjust: inherit; font-kerning: inherit; font-feature-settings: inherit; font-variation-settings: inherit;"><span style="line-height: inherit; display: inline;" id="fs_TCDEOYZPO000000000000000000000fs">2</span>:</em> Fair value determined using significant other observable inputs.</span></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">Level <em style="font-style: inherit; font-variant: inherit; font-weight: inherit; font-stretch: inherit; line-height: inherit; font-optical-sizing: inherit; font-size-adjust: inherit; font-kerning: inherit; font-feature-settings: inherit; font-variation-settings: inherit;"><span style="line-height: inherit; display: inline;" id="fs_DMR77TPF3K00000000000000000000fs">3</span>: </em>Fair value determined using significant unobservable inputs.</span></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><br/></p>
<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">Our financial instruments measured at fair value on a recurring basis are summarized below:</span></p>
<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt 0pt 10pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: 'times new roman', times; font-size: 10pt; line-height: inherit;">In addition, the financial services segment uses investor commitments and forward sales of mandatory MBS to hedge its mortgage-related interest rate exposure. These instruments involve, to varying degrees, elements of credit and interest rate risk. Credit risk is managed by entering into MBS forward commitments, option contracts with investment banks, federally regulated bank affiliates and loan sales transactions with permanent investors meeting the segment&#8217;s credit standards. Our risk, in the event of default by the purchaser, is the difference between the contract price and fair value of the MBS forward commitments and option contracts. At <em style="font-style: inherit; font-variant: inherit; font-weight: inherit; font-stretch: inherit; line-height: inherit; font-optical-sizing: inherit; font-size-adjust: inherit; font-kerning: inherit; font-feature-settings: inherit; font-variation-settings: inherit;"> <span id="fs_PBK8OXZGG000000000000000000000FM" style="line-height: inherit;">October 31, 2025</span></em>, we had <em style="font-style: inherit; font-variant: inherit; font-weight: inherit; font-stretch: inherit; line-height: inherit; font-optical-sizing: inherit; font-size-adjust: inherit; font-kerning: inherit; font-feature-settings: inherit; font-variation-settings: inherit;">no</em> open mandatory investor commitments to sell MBS.</span></p>
